The UA is open to the public so that all Penn students can attend our General Body Meetings every Sunday at 8 p.m. in Huntsman Hall. The full schedule of dates, times, and locations will be published once the year begins. If you would like to be more involved, you can run for an elected position or apply to be an associate member. 
The application to be an Associate Member will be up beginning of the Fall semester. 
Hope to see you soon!

penn-product-club.name: Product Space @ Penn
penn-product-club.description:
Students in this Univeristy of Pennsylvania club will be able to find a community around product management and learning about the product lifecycle. Students will be able to learn about the different aspects of being a product manager, build their skills through consulting endeavors, and have a community to help them develop their career.
Application form for Fall 2025: 
Coming soon
penn-product-club.how_to_get_involved:
We aim to be a space for everyone interested in product management to learn, grow, and discover. 
We have an open membership model - you can become a General Member by signing up for our newsletter. As a general member, you are invited to attend our product management events advertised in the newsletter.
We also look for committed students to join our Fellowship program every semester, which has a short application and interview process. Becoming a Fellow will give you access to our integrated curriculum, which will help you break into product management. 
For our Fall 2025 Fellowship program, attend our Information Session (detail coming soon). 
Ask us if you have any questions by email or by attending one of our events. We are excited to explore together!

offthebeat.name: Off The Beat
offthebeat.description:
Off The Beat is the premier modern rock & pop student a cappella group at the prestigious University of Pennsylvania. Rooted in rock music, our repertoire now spans a range of genres from pop and R&B to electronic and funk. 
Founded in 1987 and now in our 39th year, Off The Beat has become one of the most decorated collegiate a cappella groups in the US winning over 30 CARA Awards, being featured on 17 Best of Collegiate A Cappella (BOCA) albums, and starring in the second season of POP TV's aca-documentary television series, "Sing it On!"
offthebeat.how_to_get_involved: Like and follow our Facebook and Instagram pages to stay updated on all things Off The Beat! Also, check out our discography of our 29+ albums on Spotify and / or Apple Music @ "Off The Beat".

girl-stempowerment-penn.name: Girl STEMpowerment @ Penn
girl-stempowerment-penn.description: Girl STEMpowerment is a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization that began in 2018; we strive to increase young girls' interest in STEM through hands-on educational experiences which also help them develop creativity, cooperative learning abiliities, and critical thinking skills, thus enabling them to discover new ideas and create new options.
girl-stempowerment-penn.how_to_get_involved:
Fill out this short application to join our club! Due Sunday September 13th, 11:59 PM. All students are welcome to apply.
Application Form 
Open positions will include student educator, curriculum developer, operations manager, etc. As this is a newly formed chapter of the organization Girl STEMpowerment, we need all the help we can get to build from the ground up in preparation for our workshops!

west-african-vibe.name: West African Vibe Dance Group
west-african-vibe.description: Founded by five undergraduate first-year students at the University of Pennsylvania (Penn) in 2013, West African Vibe (WAVe), performs dances inclusive of the African Diaspora, with an emphasis on modern and contemporary forms of African Dance in an effort to contribute to the Penn community's perspective of African culture.
west-african-vibe.how_to_get_involved: Check the WAVe instagram for updates regarding auditions, no prior dance experience is required!

climbing.name: Climbing Club
climbing.description: We are a student group at Penn who love to climb and want to share our passion for rock climbing with others. We aim to be an inclusive place where anyone can come, meet other climbers, and climb, whether they're just starting out or already have experience. We hope to climb a lot, keep the stoke high, and introduce people to climbing outdoors. No experience necessary, just an interest in climbing!
climbing.how_to_get_involved: Anyone interested is welcome to join us at our weekly meetings (Tuesdays and Thursdays 8:30-10:30PM) at the Pottruck Climbing Wall.

bloomers.name: Bloomers Comedy
bloomers.description:
Bloomers is Penn's sketch comedy group that aims to uplift comedic voices of underrepresented communities and welcome all students interested in that work. We write and produce sketch comedy both on stage and in the digital format.
The heart of Bloomers has long been its completely student-run productions. Currently, Bloomers shows are held in October and March. Our shows are composed of completely new material, written by each year’s group of Bloomers, and often have an overarching theme. Join any one of our 6 sections to help us create our shows!
Our Cast choreographs, directs, and performs an original SNL-esque sketch comedy show each Fall and Spring. Band arranges and performs songs during the shows and writing ideates our show concepts while creating scripts from the ground up. Tech constructs immersive sets while managing light and sound design. Costumes designs all character attire and Biz (Business) manages all things production!

penn-undergraduate-criminology-society-p.name: The Ivy Criminology Collective (ICC)
penn-undergraduate-criminology-society-p.description: The Ivy Criminology Collective (ICC) is a Student Organization at the University of Pennsylvania for all Penn undergraduate students interested in exploring the field of criminology. We host numerous events aimed at creating a community of undergraduates interested in criminology both here at Penn and in the field at large. We are excited to offer regular roundtables with criminology faculty, criminal justice-related internship panels with upperclassmen, career panels with professionals in the field, and more. You do NOT need to be a criminology major to join. We welcome every undergraduate at Penn interested in criminology!
penn-undergraduate-criminology-society-p.how_to_get_involved: Keep a look out on our instagram for upcoming events!

campaign-for-working-families-at-penn.name: Volunteer Income Tax Assistance at Penn (VITA @ Penn)
campaign-for-working-families-at-penn.description:
Volunteer Income Tax Assistance at Penn is a student-run organization at the University of Pennsylvania.
FALL 2026 APPLICATION (due end of day September 18th) = https://forms.gle/RcTyEU2e2zk4vmUU9
VITA @ Penn's mission is to champion the financial well-being and economic mobility of individuals and families in the Philadelphia area. We are driven by the belief that every individual and family deserve respect, dignity, and the tools/information to succeed. We strive to strengthen partnerships between the University of Pennsylvania and the local Philadelphia community in order to create lasting positive change.
Every spring, we volunteer with Campaign for Working Families (CWF) to provide free tax preparation services to the Philadelphia community. In tax season 2024 (Spring 2025), Penn students were directly involved in returning over $2.6 million dollars to Philadelphia residents. With the expansion of this program, we aim to double this figure.

penn-band.name: Penn Band
penn-band.description: The Penn Band was founded in 1897, making us one of the oldest student groups on campus. With about 150 members from 25 states and 14 countries, we are also one of the biggest groups at Penn and one of the largest bands in the Ivy League. We assemble over 100 times each academic year, making us among the most active college bands in the country.
penn-band.how_to_get_involved:
The Penn Band attends Penn football games and most men's and women's basketball games. We also travel to select Penn football and basketball games at other Ivy League / Northeastern schools. Besides sports, we represent Penn at special events in Philadelphia and have a robust program of community outreach, including visiting local elementary schools to inspire a love for music, and inviting high school band students to play alongside us at games!
The band also hosts social gatherings, movie/game nights, and other section-specific events for its members throughout the year!
Everyone is welcome to join the Penn Band! We have no tryouts, applications, or auditions. It's never too late to join – we practice every Monday at 6pm and every Wednesday at 8:30pm. Email us at join@pennband.net or fill out our interest form (linked under "Join" on our website, pennband.net/join) to be sure to get all the details. See you there!
Questions? Feel free to email join@pennband.net

penn-cycling-and-triathlon.name: Penn Cycling
penn-cycling-and-triathlon.description:
A student organization at the University of Pennsylvania
We are the University of Pennsylvania Cycling Club. We support riders of all ages, backgrounds, and skill levels from across Penn, and are active members of the local Philadelphia cycling community. 
Although our primary focus is on road cycling, we have a sizable triathlon contingent. We even host winter cross-training to help members stay at their best when the weather gets low. Penn Cycling’s racers compete in USA Cycling’s Eastern Collegiate Cycling Conference, but the majority of our members are casual commuters, relaxed long distance tourists, or new riders looking to explore what the sport has to offer.

penn-buddhism-club.name: Meditation and Buddhism at Penn
penn-buddhism-club.description: Meditation and Buddhism at Penn is a student club dedicated to helping our members and community practice mindfulness and meditation while also learning more about Buddhism. We offer weekly meetings that begin with a guided meditation and are followed by an engaging discussion of a topic relating to mindfulness, Buddhism or anything that is helpful to our members. We also offer a weekend meditation retreat to the local Won Buddhism Center, regular meditation sessions throughout the week, and more!
penn-buddhism-club.how_to_get_involved:
Join our Groupme & listserv, and follow us on IG!
Groupme 
Email List 
Instagram

clio-society.name: Clio Society
clio-society.description:
Named after Clio, the Greek Muse of history.
“Our goal is to give students a platform within the museum where they can enhance and strengthen their undergraduate experience through the Penn Museum’s many resources.”
Clio brings together students who share a common interest in and appreciation for museums, culture, and art. Members will gain a greater understanding of world cultures, arts and culture professions, and the museum field.
Members can train to become Museum docents, volunteer for Museum programming, participate in behind the scenes tours of Museum collections, learn object-based teaching, invite guest speakers, organize events for students, and attend Clio-sponsored visits to other museums.
We welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join! No experience with the Penn Museum is necessary.
clio-society.how_to_get_involved:
Fill out our application form here: 
https://forms.gle/fxakoohvwQfvLENM7 
To sign up for our newsletter: 
https://tinyurl.com/cliosocietysubscribe

the-black-designers-society.name: Black Designers Society
the-black-designers-society.description:
We, the members of The Black Designers' Society, come together with a shared vision and a collective commitment to support and advocate for the professional, academic, and social development of Black students in the planning and design profession, as well as to foster community & allyship among prospective students, current students, and alumni at the University of Pennsylvania.
In solidarity, we commit ourselves to supporting one another, cultivating mentorship opportunities, advocating for equitable policies and practices, and engaging with communities to address urban planning challenges faced by Black and brown communities. By fostering an inclusive and supportive network, we aspire to empower future leaders in city planning who will champion diversity, equity, and justice in the realm of city planning and its related fields.
the-black-designers-society.how_to_get_involved: Students are welcome to attend any events hosted by BDS in order to consider themselves a part of our club membership.

wharton-women-in-investing-wwin.name: Wharton Women in Investing (WWIN)
wharton-women-in-investing-wwin.description: Our mission is to empower women to succeed as investors and adjacents across finance, including private equity, venture capital, hedge fund, mutual fund, investment management, banking, and legal industries. We seek alliance from our male allies to drive this mission forward.

penn-baking-club.name: Baking Club @ Penn
penn-baking-club.description: Baking Club @ Penn is a student group at the University of Pennsylvania. Our mission is to foster a community of students who enjoy baking and want to share/learn new recipes and techniques. Whether you have been baking for years or just like to eat cookies, this club is open to everyone at all experience levels. Our aim is to not only have fun while baking some really delicious food, but to also learn about the history and science of baking, as well as share our baked goods with the greater Penn and Philly communities.
penn-baking-club.how_to_get_involved: Everyone is welcome! Just fill out this form to join our mailing list: https://forms.gle/Q2GAHKzB3zvbkfk79 :)

penn-bsl.name: Black Student League
penn-bsl.description: The Black Student League (BSL) was established to connect and support students interested in Black culture and strengthen bonds across the African Diaspora. By engaging with our heritage, members can better understand diverse cultural histories and inclusively educate the broader campus community. BSL offers an open and welcoming environment for all students to navigate the University, making the Ivy League experience more accessible and fruitful through mentorship programs, socials, open forums, and cross-cultural initiatives. Today, BSL serves as a facilitator, advocate, and catalyst for issues concerning the African Diaspora, campus life, and student well-being. Membership, programming, and leadership opportunities are open to all Penn students.

chess.name: Chess Club at Penn
chess.description: The Chess Club at Penn is a student-run organization dedicated to fostering a vibrant chess community through learning, training, and collaboration. Our mission is to engage undergrad and grad students in the intellectual and social dimensions of chess while strengthening connections with the broader Philadelphia community. We host tournaments, workshops, and interactive events that welcome players of all levels to sharpen their skills, share knowledge, and build camaraderie. We also compete at the highest level in the National Collegiate and Inter-Ivy League championships. Our aim is to create a collaborative space where students can grow as players, thinkers, and leaders while contributing to a culture of strategic curiosity and community engagement.
chess.how_to_get_involved:
Join our Email List and GroupMe:
Email List | GroupMe 
Follow us on social media:
Instagram | Facebook | LinkedIn 
Email us with any questions at upennchessclub@gmail.com.
Everyone is welcome. We hope to see you soon!

jacques-edward-thompson.name: DJ@Penn
jacques-edward-thompson.description: DJ@Penn is the University of Pennsylvania’s student group for anyone interested in DJing, whether you’re a beginner, a seasoned performer, or someone curious about the craft. As a student-run organization, we provide resources, training, and opportunities to help you grow your skills and connect with others who share a passion for music.
jacques-edward-thompson.how_to_get_involved: Anyone can join DJ@Penn – even if you've never DJed before or are just interested in the field. We offer introductory training for those who want to learn, and have many leadership positions that don't involve DJing.

padt.name: Pan-Asian Dance Troupe
padt.description: We are a student dance troupe at the University of Pennsylvania seeking to celebrate and educate the community on Pan-Asian culture through traditional, modern, and fusion dances, and to establish an organization in which people of all nationalities can learn to express themselves through the art of dance!
padt.how_to_get_involved: Our audition process will entail an open audition and a selective callback audition. Our open audition dates and times for Fall 2026 are 5-7PM on Sunday, 8/30, and 9:30-11:30PM on Monday, 8/31. You only need to attend one of the open auditions. Check out our Instagram and head to our website here for more info, and fill out the interest form linked under the Fall 2026 Auditions tab to get email updates!

quaker-girls-dance-team.name: Quaker Girls Dance Team
quaker-girls-dance-team.description:
We’re the Quaker Girls Dance Team, the University of Pennsylvania’s student-run spirit dance team. Founded in 2000, we perform at Penn home football and basketball halftimes, including the Philadelphia Big 5 tournament at the Wells Fargo Center. Each spring, we also participate in the NBA 76ers Halftime Show.
The team is fully student-led, with all choreography, leadership, and operations managed by members. Our routines incorporate a mix of dance styles, including jazz, hip-hop, contemporary, and pom.
quaker-girls-dance-team.how_to_get_involved: For the '26-'27 School Year: Our Open Workshop is on Friday, August 28th @ Platt Performing Arts House Room 175 from 6-7:30pm. Our Auditions will be Monday, August 31st from 7:30-9:30 pm, in Studio 409 @ Pottruck Gym. If you have any questions please email us or DM us (qgdance@gmail.com/@pennquakergirls)

penn-philippine-association.name: Philippine Association (PPA)
penn-philippine-association.description: We are a student group at the University of Pennsylvania with a goal to promote the awareness and appreciation of Philippine culture through cultural dance performances, potlucks, cooking sessions, karaoke, discussion forums, and most importantly, spending quality time with each other. Our club is open to anyone, regardless of ethnicity or background!
penn-philippine-association.how_to_get_involved: Join our GroupMe, follow us on Instagram, and subscribe to our newsletter!

penn-club-gymnastics.name: Club Gymnastics at Penn
penn-club-gymnastics.description:
Club Gymnastics at Penn is a student-run club team at the University of Pennsylvania managed through PennRec. We aim to provide an opportunity for both beginners and experienced gymnasts to develop their skills and continue their love of the sport.
Club Gymnastics at Penn is part of the National Association of Intercollegiate Gymnastics Clubs (NAIGC), which allows us to compete in meets throughout the year and compete in the National Championships at the end of the spring semester. The nearly 80 NAIGC clubs across the country form a friendly community in which gymnasts, from beginners to advanced, can learn and compete together.
penn-club-gymnastics.how_to_get_involved: Send an email to pennclubgym@gmail.com for more info or check us out on IG @pennclubgymnastics !! Fall 2026 Practice Schedule will be posted soon!

the-songwriters-collective.name: The Songwriters Collective
the-songwriters-collective.description: Songwriters Collective is Penn's premiere group for student songwriters. Working collaboratively, with an intention of building intimate and safe community, we create sets of entirely new music and perform together each semester. We meet weekly on Sundays to jam together, workshop our songs and collaborate on new music through writing exercises and prompts.
the-songwriters-collective.how_to_get_involved:
You can sign up for Fall 2026 auditions at the link below! Auditions will be held Saturday September 5th and Sunday the 7th from 10am-4pm. 
Sign up here: https://forms.gle/1BVWz9KxoqP9cSbu8
Follow our Instagram to learn more about the club and find out about upcoming events or gigs :)

penn-jazz-ensemble.name: The Jazz Ensemble at Penn
penn-jazz-ensemble.description: The Jazz Ensemble at Penn (formerly known as Penn Jazz) is the big band jazz ensemble at the University of Pennsylvania. The group is student-run and led, with the assistance of musical director Dr. Ryan Tomski. Undergraduate and graduate students are all welcome. The Jazz Ensemble at Penn was formed in the fall of 1973 and has performed with numerous jazz legends throughout its history, such as Dizzy Gillespie, McCoy Tyner, the Count Basie Orchestra, Wynton Marsalis, and most recently, Christian McBride. We present a show toward the end of each semester to exhibit our hard work in mastering jazz and vocal tunes spanning many genres. Our performances are enthusiastically attended by Penn students and faculty, friends and family, and members of the greater Philadelphia community.
penn-jazz-ensemble.how_to_get_involved:
Connect with us on other platforms: linktr.ee/pennjazz
Sign up for an audition: 2026-27 Auditions 
Questions: info.pennjazz@gmail.com / Alexander Hyams, President

penn-thillana.name: Penn Thillana
penn-thillana.description:
Our team is Penn's ~premier~ classical Indian dance team. Created in 2005, Thillana is a student group at the University of Pennsylvania that aims to provide a space for people trained or interested in classical dance (ranging from Bharatantyam to Kathak to Kuchipudi) to come together and learn from each other’s varied experiences. While staying true to our dance forms, we add a modern twist through messaging, storylines, and music. Thillana is a new take on a fusion dance team!
Keep an eye out for information on our Fall 2025 plans. Feel free to message Shikha and Nina at pennthillana@gmail.com if you have any questions or just want to say hello!!

mens-ice-hockey.name: Men's Ice Hockey
mens-ice-hockey.description: Join the men's club ice hockey team! We are a team that competes in the ACHA D2 conference, playing other colleges in the tri-state area. We practice twice a week and will play games on weekends. We have won our conference three out of the past four and hope to return to the regional tournament this year.
mens-ice-hockey.how_to_get_involved: Tryout schedules will be posted on the team Instagram.

social-deduction-club.name: Social Deduction Club
social-deduction-club.description: A student group at the University of Pennsylvania created primarily to let students play mafia weekly, create and administer escape rooms, movie nights, murder mystery parties and most importantly, have fun!
social-deduction-club.how_to_get_involved: We do not have applications, nor do we turn away members. To become part of our organization, one must be a member of the University of Pennsylvania with a willingness to try new things, and an enjoyment of the phenomenon that can only occur in social settings. Our principle recruiting techniques are in the provided SAC fairs and by word of mouth.

penn-ski-snowboard.name: Penn Ski and Snowboard Team
penn-ski-snowboard.description:
We are a club team, affiliated with the University of Pennsylvania, of mainly undergraduates (grad students welcome too!) who love to ski, snowboard, and have a blast on the slopes. If you enjoy being on the mountain, you'll love being a part of our group.
While there's a lot of team interaction regardless of the time of year, our season centers on five to six weekend trips typically beginning in early January and culminating in mid to late February. We leave on Friday afternoons and return to Penn on Sunday evenings. Our weekends are spent racing and free skiing with other East Coast schools at mountains in NY, NJ, and PA as a part of the USCSA Atlantic Highlands Conference.
penn-ski-snowboard.how_to_get_involved: Find us at NSO and SAC tabling events (and follow us on IG @penn.ski) to learn more about the club and how to join for the 2025-2026 season!

unearthed.name: UnEarthed Penn
unearthed.description: UnEarthed is a student-run publication at the University of Pennsylvania that publishes creative, inspirational, and educational magazines for elementary and middle schoolers in the West Philadelphia area. Our mission is to ensure that every child has the opportunity to unearth their intellect and curiosity. Each semester, our team of writers, editors, and designers collaborates to create a magazine that we share with local children in person and online. Past articles include topics like the history of coffee, how different animals sleep, why hot water feels cold, and so much more!
unearthed.how_to_get_involved:
Applications ARE OPEN and will close on Sept 6th at 11:59pm! Check our website at https://www.unearthedpenn.com/recruitment for more information. 
Writer App
Editor App
Designer App
If you have any questions, please feel free to email us at unearthed.penn@gmail.com.

penn-for-immigrant-rights.name: People for Immigrant Rights
penn-for-immigrant-rights.description:
People for Immigrant Rights is the first organization at the University of Pennsylvania led by undocumented youth and allies looking to increase the dialogue on immigration.
We look to provide a safe space to discuss the issues pertinent to the current immigration system and their effect on the community. Through such discussions we hope to engage the Penn community on behalf of equal access to higher education and equal opportunities for immigrant students regardless of immigration status. Our priority is to empower undocumented students and immigrant communities to raise their voices and challenge the system.
penn-for-immigrant-rights.how_to_get_involved:
There is no application process-- Just show up to our events, email us, or reach out to us via Instagram @peopleforimmigrantrights
Sign up to our listserv: https://linktr.ee/peopleforimmigrantrights :)
Please do not email pennforimmigrantrights@gmail.com as that email is INACTIVE and will not be seen. For all inquiries, email peopleforimmigrantrights@gmail.com.

penn-chinese-calligraphy.name: Chinese Calligraphy at Penn
penn-chinese-calligraphy.description: Chinese Calligraphy at Penn is a club at the University of Pennsylvania dedicated to providing a community for students who are interested in learning more about traditional Chinese art and calligraphy. Through weekly practices and presentations on the history, artists, and notable works of Chinese painting and calligraphy, we seek to bring together descendants of this time-honored tradition and promote its influence on Chinese culture.
penn-chinese-calligraphy.how_to_get_involved: Join Chinese Calligraphy at Penn! We are a looking for students passionate about Chinese calligraphy and all kinds of traditional Chinese painting. Undergrads, grad students, faculty, and staff are all welcome to join and drop by Fridays, 6-7 pm at ARCH Fireside Lounge (but please check your email as we may need to switch our locations occasionally). If you’re interested in joining the club, please email us or join our GroupMe . No application or any experience is required for general members. ** More info about board apps will follow.

round-table-dinner.name: Skeptic's Dinner
round-table-dinner.description: We provide a free meal, you come and be heard during a round table discussion about thought-provoking topics and big life questions. As an undergraduate club at the University of Pennsylvania, we strive to have a dinner table that is representative of Penn's campus in terms of race, gender, socio-economic background, and religious beliefs.
round-table-dinner.how_to_get_involved: Send us an email with your interest, and we'll send you the location or Zoom invite of our next dinner. Hope to see you there!

neurotechpenn-nap.name: Neurotech@Penn
neurotechpenn-nap.description:
Neurotech@Penn is the leading undergraduate and graduate organization advancing brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) and neurotechnology at the University of Pennsylvania. As Penn’s largest hub for neurotech, we give students hands-on experience through hackathons, interdisciplinary projects, and access to BCI hardware. Members engage with researchers, entrepreneurs, and industry leaders in guest talks, panels, and workshops, exploring both the technical and commercial sides of the field.
Our hackathons and projects bring together students from engineering, neuroscience, and computer science to build real-world BCI applications. We also participate in external hackathons and aim to connect students with leading experts, sparking conversations on the future of human-computer interaction, research, and industry opportunities.
Whether you’re an engineer, neuroscientist, entrepreneur, or simply curious, Neurotech at Penn is the place to explore, create and learn more about the field!
neurotechpenn-nap.how_to_get_involved: Join our WhatsApp and follow our LinkedIn for updates! https://chat.whatsapp.com/CyaGIf04j8jGX8tmBey2QQ and https://www.linkedin.com/company/penn-neurotech

fuerza.name: Fuerza
fuerza.description: Fuerza is Penn's first and only student-run Latine music group. Founded in 2019, our mission is to provide a safe space for students at Penn and in the greater Philadelphia area to creatively explore Latine culture through musical performance. We are Latine inspired, not Latine exclusive.
fuerza.how_to_get_involved: Follow @fuerzaupenn on Instagram and like us on Facebook at Fuerza UPenn for more information on how to join! Feel free to contact us at any time!

student-athlete-investment-club.name: Student-Athlete Investment Club
student-athlete-investment-club.description: The Student-Athlete Investment Club is dedicated to empowering student-athletes with the financial knowledge, skills, and resources necessary to make informed investment decisions and build long-term wealth. By blending the discipline, teamwork, and strategic thinking honed through athletics with the principles of sound financial management, we aim to create a supportive community where student-athletes can learn, collaborate, and grow as future leaders in the world of finance. Our mission is to equip members with the tools to navigate the complexities of investing, foster a mindset of financial independence, and develop a network of like-minded individuals passionate about creating lasting financial success, both on and off the field.
student-athlete-investment-club.how_to_get_involved: Open to all student-athletes (varsity or club) at the University of Pennsylvania. Apply on the Student-Athlete Investment Club homepage.

alpha-kappa-alpha-sorority-inc.name: Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, Incorporated.
alpha-kappa-alpha-sorority-inc.description: The Gamma Epsilon Philadelphia City Chapter of Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority Inc. is a chapter of dynamic, radiant, and distinguished young women. We are a student group whose leadership and dedication to service and scholarship are evident through our work on our respective campuses, throughout the North Atlantic Region, and internationally. We strive to uphold our purpose: to cultivate and encourage high scholastic and ethical standards, to promote unity and friendship among college women, to study and help alleviate problems concerning girls and women in order to improve their social stature, to maintain a progressive interest in college life, and to be of service to all mankind. The glorious and eloquent Gamma Epsilon Philadelphia City Chapter’s membership comprises five schools: Drexel University, La Salle University, Thomas Jefferson University - East Falls Campus, Saint Joseph’s University, and the University of Pennsylvania.
alpha-kappa-alpha-sorority-inc.how_to_get_involved: Follow us on our instagram & be sure to visit our national website at aka1908.com.

descendants-of-afro-americans-at-penn.name: Descendants of Afro Americans at Penn
descendants-of-afro-americans-at-penn.description: DAAP is a student organization at the University of Pennsylvania that strives to embrace and promote awareness of Afro-American culture and heritage within the Diasporic, Philadelphia, and Penn community.

grupo-quisqueyano-dominican-and-haitian-.name: Grupo Quisqueyano
grupo-quisqueyano-dominican-and-haitian-.description: GQ is a student-run group that was established for the purpose of serving the interest of the Dominican and Haitian populations of the University of Pennsylvania uniting Dominican and Haitian students and those interested in Dominican and Haitian cultures. Follow our Instagram @upenn_gq

wucc.name: Wharton Undergraduate Consulting Club (WUCC)
wucc.description:
About WUCC
The Wharton Undergraduate Consulting Club (WUCC) is one of oldest student-run consultancies at Penn. We bring together students from all four schools to help companies, ranging from local startups to F100 companies, tackle their toughest challenges.
Our Work
Each semester, our teams dive into real client projects, from creating marketing strategies to exploring new market opportunities. Consultants often work directly with clients and get hands-on experience making an impact.
Our Community
WUCC is more than just consulting; we’re a close-knit group where members find friends, mentors, and lasting connections. From club-wide socials to team dinners, you’ll always have a community to lean on :)
Get Involved
No prior consulting experience is needed. If you’re curious, collaborative, and excited to learn, we’d love to have you apply and grow with us!
wucc.how_to_get_involved:
Learn more about WUCC and the committees from our website https://www.wuccpenn.org/!
WUCC GBMs are open to all, so stay on the lookout in your inbox for upcoming events. To sign up for Listserv and find out more about the application, visit our membership page.

penn-quantum-computing-club.name: Quantum Computing Club at Penn
penn-quantum-computing-club.description:
Quantum Computing Club at Penn is a student organization centered on the promotion & participation of quantum information sciences across the undergraduate student body at Penn. Members interested in our efforts are welcome to get involved in: 
The development of quantum projects (Open-Sourced)
Hackathons & other competitions 
Host tours of quantum science labs at Penn
Conferences & networking opportunities with industry and professionals 
And possibly more!
penn-quantum-computing-club.how_to_get_involved:
Applications are currently closed for the fall semester, email us with any further inquiries.
All undergraduates & graduates are welcome, regardless of experience.
Also, feel free to check out our discord here: https://discord.gg/rDyCuWamgr

chinese-language-and-culture-club.name: Chinese Language and Culture Club
chinese-language-and-culture-club.description:
The Chinese Language and Culture Club (CLC) is a student group at the University of Pennsylvania that aims to bring a welcoming space for Chinese learners. CLC aims to encourage interaction between Chinese learners as well as share Chinese culture.
In addition to connecting experienced Chinese speakers with beginner learners, CLC will hold events that educate the Penn community about Chinese culture. These events include trips to Chinatown, eating mooncakes, community events with the community center in Philadelphia Chinatown, and events that celebrate Chinese holidays and festivals.
We welcome anyone who is passionate about learning the Chinese language and culture!
chinese-language-and-culture-club.how_to_get_involved:
To get involved, just fill out this google form to join our mailing list for the most up to date announcements. 
GroupMe: https://groupme.com/join_group/89534964/Hp0JNKp2

road2research-r2r.name: Road2Research (R2R)
road2research-r2r.description:
Traditional high school summer research programs are often inaccessible to underserved students. Many established programs exacerbate the gap in educational equity by adding a price tag or rigorous requirements, but R2R bridges this gap in Philadelphia by providing early exposure to biotechnology and research through hands-on lab experiences and eye-opening mentorship. 
R2R is a student organization at Penn that hosts weekly lab workshops at Penn for a cohort of 20 students, with future goals to expand. With a heavy emphasis on hands-on learning and mentorship, the curriculum highlights basic lab skills, practical research tools needed in academia, features career mixers, and an end-of-year research symposium. In our pilot year, we reached 450+ students!
road2research-r2r.how_to_get_involved:
Fill out this application by EOD, September 18th!
https://forms.gle/ksmP25N8UnthbTHj6

womens-club-lacrosse.name: Women's Club Lacrosse
womens-club-lacrosse.description: Penn Women's Club Lacrosse is a student group and club sport at the University of Pennsylvania governed completely by its members and our executive board works together to coach and maintain the team. We practice twice per week, and we compete intercollegiately in both the fall and the spring, playing teams in the greater Philadelphia area, New Jersey, New York, Maryland, and Delaware! In addition to being competitive, we are a social group and we like to think of ourselves as a family both on and off the field. Both undergrads and grad students are welcome to join!
womens-club-lacrosse.how_to_get_involved: Email us and we will add you to the listserv for tryout & season information

mens-water-polo.name: Men's Water Polo
mens-water-polo.description:
We are the official Men's Water Polo team at the University of Pennsylvania. 9x CWPA Mid-Atlantic Champions.
We practice 3x a week and have games throughout the fall and spring semesters. Our primary CWPA competitive season is in the fall; however, we play games year-round and participate in the American Water Polo Main Line League in the spring. 
We also host tournaments, dinners, social events, and other fun team activities throughout the year. ALL students, both undergraduate and graduate, and ALL levels, from beginner to pro, are welcome to join!
Photo by Cory Shin '25
In 2021, we won our 9th CWPA Mid-Atlantic Conference Championship and traveled to Huntsville, Alabama, where we finished in 8th place at the CWPA National Collegiate Championship.
mens-water-polo.how_to_get_involved:
Shoot us an email or a DM on Instagram for more information! Open to ALL students of ALL levels.
Our Fall 2026 Weekly Schedule: 
Tuesday: 7:45PM - 9:00PM 
Thursday: 7:45PM - 9:30PM 
Sunday: 3:30PM - 5:00PM

pennatomy.name: BioArt Lab at Penn
pennatomy.description:
BioArt Lab is a student-run organization at Penn dedicated to exploring the intersection of art, biology, and community impact. We partner with local Philadelphia schools to design and host interactive, hands-on workshops that spark creativity and curiosity. Our goal is to foster a collaborative space to introduce students to STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Art, and Mathematics). We're also hosting an Art of Science Exposition displaying student works, speaker sessions, and call for submissions to encourage visual communication of scientific knowledge.
We havce reached over 60 students at the Workshop School, and this year we are expanding to the Henry C. Lea Elementary School (through Netter Center). Whether you’re passionate about science, design, or education, BioArt Lab welcomes volunteers to help us grow our reach!

korea-penn-engineers-and-scientists-asso.name: Korea-Penn Engineers and Scientists Association
korea-penn-engineers-and-scientists-asso.description: Korea-Penn Engineers and Scientists Association (K-PEnSA) is a Korean-affiliated organization that addresses the unique cultural and academic needs of the university’s students in disciplines of engineering/sciences. Our mission is to foster a space where members can share professional insights, resources, and experiences that drive career growth and success.
korea-penn-engineers-and-scientists-asso.how_to_get_involved:
Relevant links/forms can be found at our Linktree !
For further details, please email us (pensaboard@gmail.com) or DM us on Instagram !

gamma-chapter-of-delta-sigma-theta-soror.name: Gamma Chapter of Delta Sigma Theta Sorority, Inc
gamma-chapter-of-delta-sigma-theta-soror.description:
Delta Sigma Theta Sorority, Inc. is an organization of college-educated women committed to the constructive development of its members and to public service with a primary focus on the Black community.
Gamma Chapter is the chapter of Delta Sigma Theta Sorority, Inc chartered at the University of Pennsylvania.

wharton-undergraduate-real-estate-club.name: Wharton Undergraduate Real Estate Club
wharton-undergraduate-real-estate-club.description: The Wharton Undergraduate Real Estate Club is dedicated to everything real estate. We educate Penn community about the real estate industry and expose undergraduate students to various opportunities in the field. WUREC seeks to provide an intellectual environment that not only allows students to learn, but also network, recruit, travel, and build foundations for success and a career in real estate.
wharton-undergraduate-real-estate-club.how_to_get_involved:
Whether you want to learn about investing, job opportunities, or increasing your general knowledge about real estate, please feel free to go to the WUREC website and request to be added to the listserv. Then, look out for upcoming speakers, treks, social events, and classes.
WUREC provides access to the Zell/Lurie Real Estate Center's Ballard Executive Visitor Luncheon Series, the Zell/Lurie Real Estate Center's Career Mentor Program, MBA/Undergraduate Real Estate Club Mixers, and the Resume Book. 
WUREC Committee Applications open during the Fall and Spring Semesters and are the best way for students to get involved with the club. Committees include Speakers, Treks, Careers, Internal, Investments, Institute, Infrastructure, and Communications. Committee specific applications will be opened during the Fall recruiting process. We look forward to getting to know you!

womens-biomedical-society.name: Women's Biomedical Society at Penn
womens-biomedical-society.description: The mission of Women's Biomedical Society at Penn, a student group at the University of Pennsylvania, is to provide undergraduates with information and opportunities pertaining to graduate schools and careers in the biomedical field. WBSP strives to bring together a diverse group of women to (a) promote high academic achievement in science (b) connect to mentors/female STEM professionals, (c) serve the greater West Philly community, and (d) engage in science-related educational activities. We are open to all students who share an interest in the biomedical sciences.
womens-biomedical-society.how_to_get_involved: Subscribe to our club's page (bell in upper right hand corner)! Join our listserv and stay up to date with our events! GBMs are every other Wednesday.

penn-impact-investing.name: Impact Investing at Penn
penn-impact-investing.description: Impact Investing at Penn (IIP) is the premier hub for undergraduates at Penn and Wharton to explore high-impact sectors — from renewable energy to affordable housing — and the role of private capital markets in scaling them. Members have the opportunity to participate in real-world projects with VC and PE firms across sourcing, due diligence, thesis design, and thematic research, alongside a wide range of networking events and skill-building workshops.
penn-impact-investing.how_to_get_involved: Fill out our interest form to stay updated on the Fall 2026 application cycle! (https://forms.gle/HUjj6Lkrd6dgfTiy8)

harrison-anime-club.name: Anime@Penn
harrison-anime-club.description: We, Anime@Penn, form the primary student organization at the University of Pennsylvania for all activities and discussions anime-related. We invite you to join us as we celebrate Japanese media and entertainment! Open to anyone and everyone, come join us for your anime-watching needs!
harrison-anime-club.how_to_get_involved:
Get together with fellow anime and video game lovers as we gather every Friday from 8pm to 12am in the Harrison College House Mezzanine. Every week, you can suggest which shows you want to see on the big screen and several times a semester, we will also host special events such as karaokes, video game nights, and potlucks!
Join our discord to stay updated with all of our activities: https://discord.gg/4QRS4Fu! 
Join our mailing list to receives updates via our weekly newsletter: http://eepurl.com/djSTw8b9oI!

penn-science-policy-and-diplomacy-group.name: Science Policy and Diplomacy Group at Penn
penn-science-policy-and-diplomacy-group.description:
Most students in science receive little to no training in how to communicate science to non-scientists, how to advocate for the continued role of science in policymaking, or how science can contribute to global diplomacy. To address this gap, the Science Policy and Diplomacy Group at Penn (PSPDG) creates opportunities for early-career scientists at the University of Pennsylvania to get hands-on training and experience in the fields of science communication, policy, and diplomacy. PSPDG is open to all students and staff at Penn.
Sign up for our listserv on our website for up-to-date information on our events and meetings!
penn-science-policy-and-diplomacy-group.how_to_get_involved: Join our email list (https://www.pspdg.com/) to hear about upcoming meetings, events, and opportunities to gain experience in SciComm, SciDip, or SciPol!

penn-german-society.name: German Society at Penn
penn-german-society.description:
The German Society, a Student Organization at the University of Pennsylvania, provides a platform for the German-speaking community at Penn and aims to promote issues related to German-speaking countries and German as a language.
We regularly organize events like trips to the Philly Oktoberfest, the German American Conference at Harvard, or the German embassy in DC. We also invite German speakers to campus and host social gatherings for our members.
penn-german-society.how_to_get_involved:
To become a member, please email our presidents, Niklas and Rachel (nromberg@sas.upenn.edu and levy1@wharton.upenn.edu), who will send you the link to join our WhatsApp groupchat.
This is where you can find out about our upcoming events!

university-of-pennsylvania-roundnet-club.name: Club Roundnet/Spikeball at Penn
university-of-pennsylvania-roundnet-club.description: Club Roundnet/Spikeball at Penn promotes the sport of roundnet across the University of Pennsylvania community by fostering an inclusive, active environment for recreational play, skill development, and collegiate competitive opportunities.
university-of-pennsylvania-roundnet-club.how_to_get_involved:
Club Roundnet/Spikeball at Penn is your ultimate mid-week break—we make it as easy as possible to jump in, destress, sharpen your skills, and have fun!
Come to a Hit-Around
We meet weekly at the Penn Park Softball Field on Wednesday nights from 7:30-9:30pm. All skill levels are welcome! You don't need to bring a partner, a net, or have any prior experience—we will always find a spot and jump you into a game.
Join the GroupMe
Join our GroupMe (link HERE) to get weekly practice schedules, field location updates, and pickup game announcements.
Compete at Tournaments
Looking for competitive play? We travel to collegiate tournaments and compete against other universities throughout the semester. Talk to an officer at practice or look for competitive squad announcements in the GroupMe.
Connect With Us
Have questions or want to learn more? DM us on Instagram [@pennroundnet] or come chat with us on the field!

citystep.name: CityStep
citystep.description: We are a student community service group at the University of Pennsylvania that teaches dance to students in West and South Philadelphia schools. We serve as role models and mentors for the kids, introducing them to dance as a creative outlet for self-expression and development. At the end of the year, we hold an annual show with our students to perform for their friends, family, and community supporters.
citystep.how_to_get_involved:
We host open auditions every Fall semester in September and Spring Semester in February.
Interest form: https://forms.gle/AAa5dzupdQhnqwrq8
GBM - 1 hour/week
Classroom (teaching dance/arts in Philly schools) - 3 hours/week
Classroom planning meeting - 1 hour/week

penn-graduate-christian-fellowship.name: Intervarsity Graduate Christian Fellowship at Penn
penn-graduate-christian-fellowship.description: The Graduate Christian Fellowship (GCF) is the Graduate Chapter of the InterVarsity Christian Fellowship at the University of Pennsylvania. We have gatherings, both virtual and in-person, that focus on Bible study, prayer, encouraging each other in what it means to follow Jesus Christ in the university, and just plain fun. We welcome members from a diversity of academic disciplines. GCF activities are led by graduate students. The group receives organizational support from staff members and volunteers of InterVarsity Christian Fellowship, an international, interdenominational ministry to college students. Everyone is welcome to join, regardless of background!
penn-graduate-christian-fellowship.how_to_get_involved: If you're interested in joining our group, please send us an email!

bulgarian.name: Bulgarian Society
bulgarian.description: To serve as the primary cultural and social hub for students at the University of Pennsylvania interested in Bulgarian culture, history, traditions, and language. We aim to build a strong community for Bulgarian students and to promote understanding and appreciation of Bulgaria among the wider Penn community through educational, social, and cultural events.
bulgarian.how_to_get_involved: Everyone is welcome! Shoot us an email or join our WhatsApp group chat to get involved.

wharton-undergraduate-entrepreneurship-c.name: Wharton Undergraduate Entrepreneurship Club (WUEC)
wharton-undergraduate-entrepreneurship-c.description:
The Wharton Undergraduate Entrepreneurship Club (WUEC) is a student group at Penn for undergraduate students passionate about innovation, startups, and venture creation. As the largest entrepreneurship-focused student organization at Penn, with over 2,100 former and current members, we foster a community that empowers student founders and innovators through education, mentorship, and real-world opportunities.
WUEC hosts several signature speaker events featuring industry leaders such as Uber’s CFO, Warby Parker’s CEO, Insomnia Cookies’ CEO, First Round Capital’s Founder, and Keith Rabois. Beyond speaker events, members can participate in Career Treks, hands-on workshops, pitch competitions, and incubator programs designed to spark creativity and accelerate ventures from ideation to launch.
wharton-undergraduate-entrepreneurship-c.how_to_get_involved:
Apply through Penn Clubs! 
Info Session 1: September 6th JMHH G65
Sign up for a 1:1 Coffee chat with a WUEC exec before applications are due. (TBD)
Join our GBM Program: https://forms.gle/3hKNfDdDgrienYyW7
Keep up to date with our events, ways to be involved, and even internship opportunities!

the-daily-pennsylvanian.name: The Daily Pennsylvanian
the-daily-pennsylvanian.description:
The Daily Pennsylvanian, founded in 1885, is your authoritative source on everything Penn
Editorial: The Daily Pennsylvanian editorial departments work together to find and tell the most important stories on campus. Whether it's diving deep into an investigative story or capturing snapshots of people at the frontlines of Penn's history, the DP editorial side never stops making a difference. We're operating 100% remotely through the pandemic. Our editorial side consists of the following departments: News, Sports, Opinion, Multimedia, Copy, Audience Engagement, Web Development and Podcasts
Business: The Daily Pennsylvanian is a $3-million, student-run media organization. Our incredible teams work together to market our products and sustain our business. Through the DP, students experience working for a real company, with real staffers, clients, and revenues. Join one of our teams to gain an invaluable, hands-on experience unlike any other. Our business side consists of the following departments: Marketing, Analytics, Product Lab, Consulting
34th Street Magazine : 34th Street Magazine is your authority on Penn student life. We are a student magazine that empowers student voices, sheds light on student issues, and provides timely commentary on the arts and campus culture. We provide endless opportunities for a creative outlet: you can write cover stories, help envision marketing campaigns, design and lay out issues, attend press movie screenings, review top-rated restaurants, and even pitch your own content ideas. As the hub for Penn voices and narrative, Street staffers cover arts, culture, and feature content. We are looking for writers, photographers, videographers, artists, and social media whizzes to create, package, and promote Street to the Penn audience. Writers can work for our Features, Focus, Style, Arts, Film & TV, Music, or Ego sections. Multimedia staffers work with either the Photo or Video departments. Illustrators and graphic designers create visuals, including our weekly print product, as part of the Design department. Audience Engagement associates manage our social media and our newsletter, The Toast. Street provides writers the opportunity to be creative in their pursuit of journalism, teaches Audience Engagement staff how to build and promote a brand online, and gives photographers, videographers, and illustrators experience in creating engaging editorial visuals. Join Street to be part of a tight–knit community and learn from some of the most interesting and dedicated people at Penn—we promise you won’t regret it.
Under the Button : Under the Button is Penn’s go-to source for daily humor and satire.Our writing staff works around the clock to report on the stories that other media organizations wouldn’t dare touch due to editorial standards. Our video and media staff work to capture the real Penn experience through the lens of a camera we stole from the DP. We are looking for talented writers, videographers, actors, graphic designers, coders, our dignity, ten gay rats, and your best brisket recipe. If you’re an all-around funny person looking for a way to subject the rest of campus to your sense of humor, we’re the publication for you.
the-daily-pennsylvanian.how_to_get_involved: Check out https://projects.thedp.com/2022/join/. Learn about our departments and scroll down to the bottom and submit an interest form!

penn-winc.name: Women in Consulting (WinC)
penn-winc.description: Women in Consulting (WinC) empowers students at the University of Pennsylvania who are passionate about consulting. Our mission is to build a strong network of knowledge, mentorship, and opportunity by fostering connections, supporting members through every stage of the recruitment process, and creating spaces for learning, collaboration, and growth. While our programming is designed to highlight and support the experiences of women in consulting, we welcome all students who share an interest in consulting and in promoting equity within the industry. Through case partnerships, tailored workshops, mentorship programs, and networking events with industry leaders, we equip our members to enter the consulting field with confidence and impact.

south-asia-society.name: South Asia Society
south-asia-society.description:
The South Asia Society (SAS) is a student organization dedicated to promoting cultural unity and awareness among its members and the University of Pennsylvania community.
SAS's goals are:
To increase awareness of and educate the Penn community about South Asian culture and heritage.
To create an environment in which students are encouraged to explore and experience South Asian culture.
To increase awareness among, educate, and mobilize students in order to address pertinent issues that face the entire South Asian community, the South Asian collegiate community in America, and the Penn South Asian community.
To encourage social interaction between South Asian students.
To facilitate the adjustment process for incoming South Asian students at Penn.
south-asia-society.how_to_get_involved: Find all our resources at this link! [linktr.ee/southasiasociety](http://linktr.ee/southasiasociety)

jsa.name: Japan Student Association
jsa.description: JSA is a student group at the University of Pennsylvania that celebrates Japanese culture. We're a fun group of friends looking to meet other people and promote Japanese culture. We strive to bring people together with ties or interests in Japan, while also providing social and cultural activities. We also help to aid freshmen, transfers, exchange students, and English Language Program students in their adjustment to the University of Pennsylvania. Professionally, we assist the members of JSA in looking for jobs or study abroad opportunities in Japan through activities such as Boston Career Fair.
jsa.how_to_get_involved:
No expectations or applications to become a general member of JSA.
They are free to socialize, come and go, and attend any JSA event they want to!
Applications are required when applying for board positions.
Board members are responsible for organizing activities and managing JSA.
The expectations for board members depend on the position.
To learn more about board members' responsibilities, positions, and application, feel free to ask the current board members and keep up with our Instagram!
Sign up for our Listserv here !

the-penn-review-literary-magazine.name: The Penn Review Literary Magazine
the-penn-review-literary-magazine.description:
Devoted to the literary and visual arts, we are a student group and a professional literary magazine that publishes original poetry, fiction, creative nonfiction, and visual artwork, and feature a blend of emerging and established voices in our biannual print and online publication. In our seven-decade history, we’ve published works by William Carlos Williams, Allen Ginsberg, e. e. cummings, and Jennifer Egan, among others.
Sign up for our listserv here—https://www.pennreview.org/membership—and join us for our weekly meetings at the Kelly Writers House, Room 202, Tuesdays from 9:00 PM to 10:00 PM. Email pennreview@gmail.com with any questions.
the-penn-review-literary-magazine.how_to_get_involved: Join us at our weekly meetings by signing up through this Google Form: https://www.pennreview.org/contact-us

penn-glee-club.name: The University of Pennsylvania Glee Club
penn-glee-club.description:
The University of Pennsylvania Glee Club is an extracurricular performing organization with four sections: a choir, pit band, technical crew, and accompanist section.
The Glee Club performs three major concerts each year. The group sings at official campus events, as well as gigs around Philadelphia and other states in the area. Each spring, the group tours internationally. 
The Club blends heritage with modern artistry, preserving Penn’s traditions while showcasing choral and theatrical art forms. The Club is dedicated to musical excellence and fellowship.
penn-glee-club.how_to_get_involved: Fill out our interest form to stay in the loop! And sign up for our 2026 auditions here!

penn-undergraduate-chemistry-society.name: Undergraduate Chemistry Society at Penn
penn-undergraduate-chemistry-society.description: PUCS is the official ACS (American Chemical Society) Chapter at Penn established in 1940. We provide programming and professional chemistry-related events, socials, and community service in collaboration with high schools in the Philadelphia area.
penn-undergraduate-chemistry-society.how_to_get_involved:
Applications are currently LIVE and due 9/14 @ 11:59 pm: 
https://forms.gle/3oWkGQibGXK6qmFr5

sparks-dance-company.name: Sparks Dance Company
sparks-dance-company.description:
Sparks Dance Company (SDC) was founded in 1989 as Penn's premiere dance company dedicated to both performing and community service. The company, which is managed by undergraduate students, maintains a high technical level of many styles of dance including ballet, contemporary, jazz, tap, and hip hop.
In addition to weekly technique classes, each semester culminates with a self-choreographed show. Company members also perform at other popular campus events throughout the year such as the Emily Sachs Dance Benefit, various coffeehouses, and Student Performing Arts Night. In addition to all of these performance opportunities, SDC members share their love of dance through community service at various Philadelphia locales, such as the KIPP schools, the Salvation Army, and the Ronald McDonald house.

naacp.name: NAACP at the University of Pennsylvania
naacp.description:
NAACP Chapter at the University of Pennsylvania Mission Statement:
The University of Pennsylvania Chapter of the National Association for the Advancement of Colored People strives to ensure the social, political, economic, and educational equality of all persons here in the university community as well as the Greater West Philadelphia area through implementation of grassroots efforts such as direct action and community engagement.
naacp.how_to_get_involved: Attend at least three GBMs/events to be considered an active voting member.

veritas-forum-at-penn.name: Veritas Forum at Penn
veritas-forum-at-penn.description: The Veritas Forum is a student-run organization which hosts forums centered on the exploration of truth and its relevancy in human life, through the questions of philosophy, religion, science, and other disciplines.
veritas-forum-at-penn.how_to_get_involved: Please reach out to Leo Barocas at lbarocas@seas.upenn.edu if you're interested in joining the planning team.

word-for-word.name: Word for Word
word-for-word.description:
In our current society, the power of spoken word is often underutilized and undervalued. However, Word for Word strives to change that by catalyzing profound, difficult, and necessary conversations about the various medical and healthcare accessibility issues that individuals and communities are afflicted with. 
As a student organization at the University of Pennsylvania, we hope to provide a listening ear for these underrepresented individuals; we hope to illuminate the stories of patients, doctors, and people who deal with medical issues; and we hope to utilize these stories to spread awareness and garner fundraising/support for the most pressing issues in today’s world.
Outside of this scope, Word for Word also desires to bring an emphasis on the appreciation of medical humanities and art. Various poems, short stories, abstracts, and vignettes of many forms will be shared to express how the humanities and medicine are undeniably intertwined with one another.
word-for-word.how_to_get_involved: Look out on our Instagram or website for our applications!

penn-club-squash.name: Penn Club Squash
penn-club-squash.description: The Penn Club Squash Team is a co-ed, all-levels team for anyone interested in the sport of squash! We have 3 optional practices per week and >15 matches per semester. Whether you played competitively in high school or have never picked up a racket...we want you to join Penn Club Squash! Penn Club Squash is a student-run club at the University of Pennsylvania.
penn-club-squash.how_to_get_involved:
Fill out our interest form here 
Send us an email at pennclubsquash2018@gmail.com and we'll give all the info you need!

pts.name: Taiwanese Society at Penn
pts.description: Taiwanese Society at Penn is a network and community for Penn students who are interested in Taiwanese culture and affairs. We foster culture and community for both members and the greater Penn community through family group dinners, boba socials, educational workshops, dim sum trips, karaoke nights, and semester-end keystone events: Next Stop Taiwan and Night Market. We also maintains strong relationships with other APA organizations on campus to promote unity at Penn. Through ITASA leadership retreats, national conferences, and collaborative events, we aspire to reach out beyond our campus and cultivate friendships with other Taiwanese organizations. Taiwanese Society at Penn is committed to bringing Taiwanese culture to all those interested.
pts.how_to_get_involved: To get involved (and receive discounted/free admission to all of our events), just fill out this form https://forms.gle/Rpam7E17t1HLKWu58. If you are interested in being more involved, we will have General Board Member applications open in the upcoming fall. More information regarding elections and membership will be announced at the first GBM!

penn-sailing.name: Penn Sailing Team
penn-sailing.description:
The Penn Sailing Team is a community of athletes from all backgrounds and accepts members with no prior experience! The team works hard in the gym and gets to spend at least 3 days a week on the water at practice, and many weekends traveling for regattas. The Penn Sailing Team is an undergraduate student group at Penn. The team accepts new members only if they can commit to the full required schedule until the team is at capacity.
During both seasons, we have a full weekend regatta schedule of intercollegiate races. We are part of the ICSA and MAISA and sail both in-conference and out-of-conference races.
Our fall season begins when school starts in September and lasts until early November. In spring, we begin practicing in March and continue to the end of school. Practices are T/Th/Fr. We meet at 3:30pm and get back to campus by 7:15pm.
penn-sailing.how_to_get_involved: Just email me at ihclark@upenn.edu and we can get you started with the team!

penn-shotokan-karate-club.name: Karate Club at Penn
penn-shotokan-karate-club.description:
We are a student group at the University of Pennsylvania dedicated to the practice of traditional Japanese karate. We are officially recognized under International Shotokan Karate Federation (ISKF). We were founded in 2007.
We welcome any members of the Penn community to join us. We are very enthusiastic about new members joining us and offer our full support in helping you achieve excellence physically, mentally, and spiritually. Come train (and optionally compete) with us!
No prior experience necessary!
penn-shotokan-karate-club.how_to_get_involved:
We train in Pottruck Studio 414. We practice Wednesdays (7:30pm-9:30pm) and Fridays + Sundays (7-9pm). No experience required, all are welcome! Email us if you have any questions at pennshotokankarateclub@gmail.com!
Follow us on instagram: @pennkarate or join our Slack (link in bio).

chabad-house-at-penn.name: Chabad House at Penn
chabad-house-at-penn.description: Chabad is open to all students interested in exploring Jewish life on campus from any backround. Chabad is with a non-judgmental space to explore and celebrate Jewish heritage hertitage. A place to learn, explore, socialize and enjoy the cultural, educational and religious richness of Judaism.
chabad-house-at-penn.how_to_get_involved:
To receive weekly text updates, text "join" to 267-7272-770
Contact us via email if you would like to learn more or get involved: info@LubavitchHouse.com
To apply to join the student board click here: tinyurl.com/chabadboard24

global-ai-alliance.name: Global Artificial Intelligence Alliance at Penn
global-ai-alliance.description:
Global Artificial Intelligence Alliance at Penn is a student group at Penn. The core mission is to establish a globally connected AI club at Penn. The detials are as follows:
Promote
cross-disciplinary collaboration among students, scholars, and professionals from the School of Engineering and Applied Science, the School of Arts and Sciences, the Wharton School, and so on.
Encourage
innovation that integrates AI with hard technologies to create new research and entrepreneurial opportunities. 
Bridge
Penn academic, global industry, and capital through knowledge sharing, speaker events, seminar, and professional networking. 
Foster
an inclusive community that values diversity, authenticity,and collaboration, with a special focus on the academic and professional community at Penn.
global-ai-alliance.how_to_get_involved: Please contact this email (pgaia202509@gmail.com) to get involved

health-of-african-immigrants-program-hai.name: Health of African Immigrants Program at the Univ. of Pennsylvania
health-of-african-immigrants-program-hai.description: HAIP is a student-led initiative dedicated to understanding and addressing the unique health challenges African immigrants in Southwest Philadelphia face open to undergraduate students. Through community engagement, research, and collaboration, we work to bridge gaps in healthcare access and awareness.

bridging.name: Bridging the Arts and Sciences
bridging.description: Bridging the Arts and Sciences is a student-run organization at the University of Pennsylvania, committed to exploring the reciprocality between the sciences and the arts. Our mission is to allow students to question and explore how the arts and sciences interconnect and interact with one another, shaping our understanding and knowledge of the world. We host engaging arts activities where we create art that incorporates science, creative workshops, enlightening discussions, speaker events and visits to arts sites to further integrate arts and sciences together, understanding how they enhance and inspire developments with the other discipline, not viewing them as separate domains but rather interconnected. Our aim is to create a collaborative space where, by exploring and integrating both of these disciplines, students can further foster their creativity and allow students to holistically understand the meaningful connection between the arts and sciences.
bridging.how_to_get_involved:
Please reach out on our email to get involved!
(bridgingtheartsandsciences@gmail.com)

sic.name: The Social Impact Consulting Group [SIC]
sic.description:
Wharton’s Social Impact Consulting (SIC) group is a student-organized group that provides pro-bono consulting services to local, national, and even international organizations with social missions. New member applications are accepted at the beginning of each semester. The Social Impact Consulting Group exposes University of Pennsylvania students to the field of non-profit and social enterprise consulting and encourages students to develop an understanding of social responsibility as they proceed in their personal and professional careers.
Come meet us at one of our Spring 2026 info sessions!
- Tuesday, January 20th, 7-8 PM in JMHH G65
- Monday, January 26th, 7:30-8:30 PM in JMHH G65
