every-nation-campus.how_to_get_involved: Please contact Nozomi Hunter @ (703) 627-6882 for more information! Also, feel free to check out our website, Instagram page, or fill out the Google form!

penn-public-policy-consulting.name: Policy Consulting Group at Penn (PPC)
penn-public-policy-consulting.description:
(All info is updated for Fall 2026).
ABOUT US: 
The Policy Consulting Group at Penn (PPC) is a nonpartisan, pre-professional student organization presenting student-led research and policy solutions on pressing issues at all levels of government. In recent years, we’ve partnered with leading organizations — such as Freedom House, UNFPA, UNICEF and Hyundai America — on policy projects, white papers, and youth engagement strategies, sat down with UN Ambassadors and diplomats, and conducted hundreds of successful policy meetings with Senators, Congressional Representatives, and executive agencies. 
PPC envisions a world where students and youth are recognized as stakeholders in key policy decisions. Every semester, we partner with high-level clients in local, state, federal, and international government to conduct policy research and present solutions directly to decision-makers at Philadelphia City Hall, Capitol Hill, the United Nations, and beyond.
penn-public-policy-consulting.how_to_get_involved:
PPC is excited to welcome new members in the fall of 2026! Please see below for important links and information:
APPLICATION: Our application closed on Tuesday, September 8.
Listserv: Please fill out this form to be added to receive updates from PPC!
Please reach out to upennpolicy@gmail.com with any questions or concerns! Be sure to follow us on Instagram @pennpolicyconsulting for the latest updates.

wharton-retail-club.name: Wharton Retail Club
wharton-retail-club.description: Wharton Retail Club is a student organization at the University of Pennsylvania dedicated to empowering undergraduates who are passionate about the retail industry. Our mission is to foster personal and professional growth by building a strong community that connects students with faculty and industry professionals. We aim to cultivate future leaders in retail by encouraging collaboration, developing leadership skills, and creating opportunities for students to better understand and contribute to the rapidly evolving retail landscape.
wharton-retail-club.how_to_get_involved: We hold monthly general body meetings in the evenings. Members can explore professional development opportunities, hear from industry leaders, and connect through social events. Information about involvement, applications, and upcoming programming is linked on our website and Instagram.

wharton-alumni-relations-council.name: Wharton Alumni Connections Council
wharton-alumni-relations-council.description:
Wharton Alumni Connections Council (“WACC”) is a student-run alumni relations organization that works alongside the Wharton Undergraduate Division.
The mission of the council is as follows: WACC is a group of Wharton undergraduate students that work with Wharton Undergraduate Division to promote interaction and relationship-building between students and Wharton alumni. WACC’s mission is to encourage students to take advantage of the experience and resources the alumni network provides. Programming is planned to bring alumni to students (in-person or virtually) and includes moderated panels, interactive conversations, NYC / Philly Treks, and formal fireside chats with esteemed Wharton alumni.
Members of WACC get to play an active role in suggesting, planning, and coordinating alumni events.
wharton-alumni-relations-council.how_to_get_involved: WACC only takes Wharton freshmen, as it is a four-year commitment specific to Wharton. To apply, please fill out the Penn Clubs application before the deadline.

educational-pipeline-program.name: Educational Pipeline Program
educational-pipeline-program.description: The Educational Pipeline Program is a student group operated by the Perelman School of Medicine and facilitated by the University of Pennsylvania's Netter Center for Community Partnerships. Pipeline works to provide mentorship and education for high school students while exposing them to a variety of careers in medicine and healthcare. With support and training, Penn students get the unique opportunity to teach lessons in neurology, cardiology, and gastroenterology to students in Philadelphia high schools from backgrounds underrepresented in medicine.

quadramics.name: Quadramics Theatre Co.
quadramics.description:
Quadramics is a student group at Penn who form a close-knit community of people who love to create theatre and have fun together! 
Quadramics is also the theatre group focused on enjoying life and getting the best experience possible out of running and working on an entirely student-run production. We are fun-loving, hardworking-more-often-than-not, ridiculous, zany people who share a passion for good times and great theatre—so come join us for the fun, madness, and, as always, the drama!
In the fall we produce a play, and in the spring we produce the famous Spring Fling musical. Be on the lookout for our Fall show announcement on our social media pages!
quadramics.how_to_get_involved:
Come out to auditions or tech interviews! If a member is involved in a show (acting, tech, etc.), they are expected to attend one production meeting per week. We hold board elections during the spring semester!
This semester we will be producing The Picture of Dorian Gray, based on the novel by Oscar Wilde and adapted for the stage by Aaron Tokay. Check our Instagram for information on how to audition.

yarnaholics.name: Yarnaholics
yarnaholics.description:
If you are looking for a fun atmosphere with others who share your yarn interests, you have found the right club. Yarnaholics, a student organization at the University of Pennsylvania, provides a spectrum of benefits where you can work on your own projects, learn new techniques, teach others, bond over outings (like yarn shopping), and more. You will be hooked in no time!
In fall 2025, we meet weekly in JMHH F65 every Wednesday from 7pm to 8pm
yarnaholics.how_to_get_involved: Show up to meetings! Email us if you have any questions :)

renewal-college-fellowship.name: Renewal College Fellowship
renewal-college-fellowship.description:
We are the college fellowship of Renewal Presbyterian Church (4633 Cedar Avenue) on Penn's campus. We are a Christ-centered community, and we hope that through our ministry, you can have a personal encounter with Jesus Christ, learn and experience the power of the Gospel, and participate in God's great commission in this city.
We invite you to join our Sunday services, large group college meetings on Fridays, and weekly community group meetings where we study God's word. Our fellowship also goes beyond these programs as we walk life with one another, pointing each other to Christ through discipleship, and living our lives as college students in faith. All are welcome to see if RCF can be a place you call your spiritual home!
renewal-college-fellowship.how_to_get_involved:
Schedule
Sunday Service: 10:30AM @ Renewal
Friday Large Group Meetings: 7:30PM @ Renewal
Community Group Meetings: Tuesdays, Wednesdays, OR Thursdays at 7:30PM
Click here to join our Facebook Group where we have all our group chats, announcements, and the information needed to get plugged in.
You can also message our Facebook page or our Instagram account to learn more!

penn-club-baseball.name: Club Baseball at Penn
penn-club-baseball.description:
Mission Statement: 
Club Baseball at Penn is an athletic organization that strives to provide student-athletes with the opportunity to play baseball while developing a strong sense of team values and camaraderie.
penn-club-baseball.how_to_get_involved:
Contact Kethan Shirodkar (kshirod1@sas.upenn.edu) or Michael Yelpo (myelpo@seas.upenn.edu) for more information, including a tryout date.
For the tryout, please come with whatever equipment you have, and at the very least, a glove. We will have bats that you can borrow to use in the batting cages if you do not have your own.
The Team: We are part of the National Club Baseball Association, which consists of teams from across the country. We play a Fall season from September-November and a Spring season from March-May. Practices are held twice a week, both at Meiklejohn Stadium (Penn's Varsity Baseball Stadium) from around 5-7pm. We usually play 3-5 series per semester, each consisting of a weekend doubleheader. Our roster sits around 20 players or so. The team consists of Penn undergraduate and graduate students. Tryouts are held in early September and in early March.

service-link.name: Service Link
service-link.description: Established in 2011 by the Center for Public Health Initiatives at Penn, Service Link is the first and leading student-led social work volunteer group at Penn. We work to connect Philadelphians with resources for good health, such as emergency and short-term housing, health insurance, subsidized food programs, financial services, and more.
service-link.how_to_get_involved:
We host information sessions at the beginning of each semester; information can be found on our Instagram. We also have a recorded information sessions available on our website.
If you are interested in applying, please visit the Volunteer tab on our website! If you have any questions, please feel free to visit our website or reach out to our Director of Recruitment and Marketing, Megan Xie (meganxie@sas.upenn.edu).

fgli-dab.name: First-Generation/Low-Income Dean's Advisory Board
fgli-dab.description:
The First-Generation and/or Limited Income (FGLI) Dean’s Advisory Board is a
student organization at Penn that serves the purpose of facilitating transparent
conversation between the academic and social needs of FGLI students and the Penn Administration. We are made up of a general body and executive board that strive to research the issues that would improve and uplift the FGLI community. Our primary focus is in the College, but we do advocate for all FGLI students across the four undergraduate schools.
fgli-dab.how_to_get_involved:
Hi! We're super excited that you are interested in FGLI DAB! You can become a general member by attending our open forums and events! We also have four committees: Community Engagement, Professional Development, Mental Health, and Research. Committee applications open in the spring, but active general members may be invited to join a committee at times.
Follow us on Instagram to stay up to date! :) @fglidab

hong-kong-student-association.name: Hong Kong Student Association at Penn
hong-kong-student-association.description: The Hong Kong Student Association (HKSA) is a student group at the University of Pennsylvania. We hope to share with the Penn community what makes Hong Kong so special. HKSA celebrates the unique culture of Asia's most dynamic city, and welcomes Penn students from all backgrounds!
hong-kong-student-association.how_to_get_involved: Keep an eye out for our iconic dimsum events, cultural celebrations, professional panels, recruitment info, etc.!

penn-masala.name: Penn Masala
penn-masala.description: Penn Masala, comprised of students from the University of Pennsylvania, is the world’s first and premier South Asian a cappella group, founded in 1996 with the desire to create music that traversed traditional cultural boundaries and captured the experience of growing up with both Eastern and Western cultures. As the first group in the world to bring South Asian music to a cappella, Masala continues to expand the boundaries of South Asian-Western fusion. Since we started off in ’96, we’ve performed in India, at the White House, the Indian International Film Academy (IIFA) Awards, the Paris Olympics, and the group was featured in the Hollywood feature film and soundtrack for Pitch Perfect 2. To date, Penn Masala has released 13 studio albums, most recently 1996 in May 2026.
penn-masala.how_to_get_involved: Reach out to us on socials or at info@pennmasala.com or fill out our interest form

heart-health-penn.name: Heart Health @ Penn
heart-health-penn.description:
Our mission is to empower students to raise awareness about heart disease, address the unique needs of the West Philadelphia community, and reduce cardiovascular-related deaths.
This student-led organization addresses cardiovascular disease in two primary ways:
1. Community Engagement - Members will have the opportunity to organize and participate in CPR training sessions, design and distribute educational materials, and engage with local residents to promote heart health.
2. Premedical Opportunities - Members can volunteer at hospitals in the University of Pennsylvania Health System or shadow physicians to prepare for a career in medicine, committing to a lifelong dedication to community health.
heart-health-penn.how_to_get_involved:
Please fill out our application.
Link to Application (Due 9/19 at 11:59 PM):
https://forms.gle/qG9p9CUBdhbxJr4fA 
Please contact hearthealthpenn@gmail.com for more information, or if you have questions!

sargam.name: Sargam
sargam.description: Sargam is one of America's first student groups dedicated to performing and promoting South Asian fusion music. Established in 2004 by students at the University of Pennsylvania, Sargam’s ensemble brings together a diverse set of music ranging from Hindustani, Carnatic and Western classical to South Asian and Western pop, rock, jazz, and more.
sargam.how_to_get_involved:
IMPORTANT FOR FALL 2026: Please fill out this interest form with your information so we can contact you when auditions open! 
https://forms.gle/V3Ao6fgYRD2qKqwY6
We will hold auditions on August 29-30 for Fall 2026. We require all interested members to prepare a 3-5 minute piece for the instrument (including vocals) they are auditioning for, as well as learning pre-prepared selections based on instrument. It's a collaborative and welcoming space, and we're excited to meet you all!

classics-board.name: Classics Board
classics-board.description:
Penn's "Classics Board" is both a student club and Undergraduate Advisory Board all at once!
We do several things:
Serve as a liaison between students and faculty, attending department meetings to advise on the curriculum and other issues.
Help students connect and network with our faculty through academic events: "Faculteas," roundtables, Certamen.
Social events to create a tight-knit community, such as movie nights, board games, Secret Caesar (gift exchange among members).
We collaborate with the Undergraduate Chair in organizing information sessions on such topics as study abroad, Senior Research Papers, and applying for graduate programs.
We help to plan the department's Senior Colloquium every April.
Feel free to email our co-chairs, John (jcheeva@sas.upenn.edu) and Selima (selimaa@sas.upenn.edu), to get involved directly, or use our club gmail (pennclassicsboard@gmail.com). We welcome new members any time during the school year!
classics-board.how_to_get_involved: Feel free to email our co-chairs, John (jcheeva@sas.upenn.edu) and Selima (selimaa@sas.upenn.edu), to get involved directly, or use our club gmail (pennclassicsboard@gmail.com). We welcome new members any time during the school year!

geography.name: Undergraduate Geography Club
geography.description: 🌏The Undergraduate Geography Club is a student group at Penn that seeks to build community and world awareness through geography 🌏
geography.how_to_get_involved:
Fill out interest form 
Join Slack 
Add calendar 
Recreational: Membership is open to all Penn undergraduates interested in geography and map-based games. Students can get involved by attending our kickoff events, general meetings, and casual GeoGuessr sessions, which are open to everyone and require no prior experience.
Competitive: Members interested in competitive play may demonstrate interest through a google form/tryouts held early each semester to join Penn's Collegiate GeoGuessr League team. Competitive members are expected to attend practices and actively participate throughout the semester.

the-shea-collective.name: The Shea Collective
the-shea-collective.description: The Shea Collective is a student group created in order to connect Black people at The University of Pennsylvania who experience misogynoir (prejudice those who are perceived or socialized as black women) and to strengthen our community. We plan to offer a space of mentorship, a support system, resources, forums/discussions, socials, and bonding events in order to connect with each other in our community. Our club is open to all who are interested.

womens-club-ultimate-frisbee.name: Women's Club Ultimate Frisbee (Venus)
womens-club-ultimate-frisbee.description: Venus is the club ultimate frisbee team at the University of Pennsylvania for all woman-matching individuals. During a regular season, we have home and away tournaments along with regular practices. Join for the sport, stay for the community! We hope to be an inclusive and supportive group for people interested in joining during these messy times. We have a wonderful social community, fun practices, and many adventures together :) Anybody is welcome to join! No experience necessary.
womens-club-ultimate-frisbee.how_to_get_involved:
We practice Tuesdays and Thursdays nights from 9-11pm on Franklin Field and 4:30-6:30 on Sundays on the Penn Park turf fields.
Email venuscaptains@gmail.com with any questions! Ask to join our slack channel (our primary form of communication)

petey-greene.name: The Petey Greene Program at Penn
petey-greene.description: Petey Greene is a student group at the University of Pennsylvania working to support the academic achievement of incarcerated people. Under the guidance of the Petey Greene Program, we provide one-on-one or small group tutoring in order to supplement educational programming in neighboring correctional institutions.
petey-greene.how_to_get_involved:
Our first GBM will be on September 23rd, Wednesday, from 7:30PM-8:30PM in Huntsman 365. Come to learn more about incarceration, education, and how to become a tutor!
Please email us at UPennPGP@peteygreene.org if you are interested in getting involved!

215records.name: 215Records
215records.description:
215Records is Penn's first record label that brings artists from the point of production to being streamed on Spotify (and all your favorite streaming platforms). Founded Spring 2024, we've built a team of in-house producers,audio engineers, A&R reps, and marketers to scout talent and get them release ready. Joining 215 is an opportunity to get hands-on experience in music label work - learning everything from studio project management, release campaigns, and distribution.
Having already supported two artists, we're always aiming to grow our roster of talent. If you're interested in learning what it takes to run a record label, or being a represented artist yourself, then 215Records is the place for you.
215records.how_to_get_involved: Email us at info@215records.com or DM us on Instagram (@215_records)

mena-undergraduate-pre-law-society.name: MENA Undergraduate Pre-Law Society
mena-undergraduate-pre-law-society.description: We are a student organization at the University of Pennsylvania. Our mission is to promote awareness about MENA issues, encourage the practice of law through offering pre-professional and networking opportunities, fostering cultural exchange, understanding geopolitical dynamics, and providing a platform for students to discuss and learn about the region. In addition, to offering mentorship through academics and networking for students interested in international affairs or intending to pursue the legal sector.
mena-undergraduate-pre-law-society.how_to_get_involved:
We are accepting all members and certain board positions for Fall 2026. Interested general members or potential board members can express interest by emailing us at upennmenals@gmail.com. 
Feel free to email us with any questions and ways to get involved!

penn-competitive-badminton-club.name: Badminton at Penn
penn-competitive-badminton-club.description:
Hi! We are Penn Badminton, a student group dedicated to promoting badminton and playing competitively against different schools across the country. 
The purpose of Penn Badminton is to build a strong competitive team and promote interest in badminton as a recreational sport in the University of Pennsylvania community. We will accomplish this goal not only by training consistently and competing every semester but also by holding recreational practice sessions and competitions on campus. 
Everybody is welcome to play in our recreational team, and people who are interested in competing in collegiate tournaments can try out for the competitive team. We're the reigning Eastern Collegiate Mid Atlantic D1 Champions!
All skill levels and years are welcome!
penn-competitive-badminton-club.how_to_get_involved: Visit our website for more information and fill out https://tinyurl.com/f25pennbadmintontryouts if you're interested in trying out for the competitive team!

moso-capital.name: Moso Capital
moso-capital.description: Moso Capital (“Moso”) an undergraduate student club on Penn's campus part of Wharton Council. We provide students real-world investing experience by working directly with venture capitalists and angel investors to source, diligence, and recommend startups for investment. Our vision is to build the next generation of investors. We envision a community where students and investors partner and collaborate side-by-side, combining classroom theory with tangible, outcome-driven work that results in real investments.
moso-capital.how_to_get_involved: Follow our Instagram at @mosocapital to stay up to date with our events!

spec-connaissance.name: SPEC Connaissance
spec-connaissance.description:
SPEC Connaissance (Conn) is the SPEC committee tasked with bringing high-profile speakers to campus who challenge, educate, and entertain the student body. We are also committed to representing diverse perspectives. As a general body member, you will offer input into our speaker selection process and attend the event for free. This includes access to a private meet and greet with speakers. We are an open community where all ideas, viewpoints, and people are welcome! 
Past speakers include:
2025 - 2026: Randall Park, Penn Badgley
2024 - 2025: Haley Lu Richardson, Tyler James Williams
2023 - 2024: Josh Peck, Victoria Justice, Daveed Diggs
2022 - 2023: Spike Lee, Stephanie Hsu
2021 - 2022: Yvonne Orji, Hunter Schafer
2020 - 2021: John Mulaney, Bob the Drag Queen, Keke Palmer, Simu Liu
2019 - 2020: Alex Moffat, Ego Nwodim, Vanessa Bayer, Mikey Day, Melissa Villasenor
spec-connaissance.how_to_get_involved:
Conn GBMs are held on Tuesdays from 9-10pm. Conn GBMs are dedicated to updating you on everything pop culture and SPEC. GBMs are open to all interested, no application needed! Join our listerv here!
See our GroupMe (https://groupme.com/join_group/109556949/lKyoVHJy) or Instagram (@specconnaissance) for week-to-week info! SPEC Connaissance is a student group at the University of Pennsylvania.

penn-history-review.name: Penn History Review
penn-history-review.description: Founded in 1991, the Penn History Review is a journal for undergraduate historical research. Published twice a year through the Department of History, the journal is a non-profit publication produced by and primarily for undergraduates. The editorial board of the Review is dedicated to publishing the most original and scholarly research submitted for our consideration. For more information about submissions, or about becoming an Editor, please contact us at phrsubmissions@gmail.com. Past issues of the PHR can be found at repository.upenn.edu/phr.
penn-history-review.how_to_get_involved: Please fill out the application at this link and send it to phrsubmissions@gmail.com no later than SUNDAY, January 29th, 2023 at 11:59 PM. We will be in contact shortly thereafter.

check-one.name: Check All
check-one.description: Check All is the University of Pennsylvania's leading multicultural student association that encourages the celebration of mixed heritage. Our goal is to explore the experiences unique to people of mixed heritage and to empower these individuals to further explore the intersection of their cultural identities. Key to this mission is an appreciation of our unique cultures: This will include food tastings, cultural demonstrations, and immersive cultural experiences.

penn-wastewise-pww.name: WasteWise at Penn
penn-wastewise-pww.description: WasteWise at Penn (WWP) is a student group at the University of Pennsylvania dedicated to creating a more sustainable campus through waste reduction, reuse, recycling, composting, and responsible resource management. We empower students to understand waste systems, engage with their communities, and turn ideas into action. Through education, collaboration, and hands-on initiatives, WWP works to make sustainable waste practices a meaningful part of campus life and extend their impact beyond Penn.
penn-wastewise-pww.how_to_get_involved: Join the GroupMe for updates or reach out to our email with questions!

new-clean-energy-advocacy-and-research-n.name: MECS at Penn
new-clean-energy-advocacy-and-research-n.description: The mission of the Maritime, Energy & Commodities Society at Penn is to build an interdisciplinary student community exploring the industries, energy technologies, and markets that power global trade. Through research, educational programs, industry engagement, and collaborative projects, we connect students with the maritime, energy, and commodities sectors while examining their financial, technological, and environmental evolution. We aim to prepare members to understand and contribute to more innovative, efficient, and resilient global systems.

wharton-ai-analytics-club-waiac.name: Wharton AI & Analytics Club (WAIAC)
wharton-ai-analytics-club-waiac.description:
WAIAC is the premier hub for students of all backgrounds and experience levels to explore, build, and engage with Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, and Business Analytics. We aim to bridge learning, community, and career outcomes by creating opportunities that are practical, collaborative, and industry-connected. Our mission is centered around four pillars:
Learning & Skill-Building: Deliver hands-on, applied learning through workshops, builder-focused sessions, and expert-led programming that equip members with practical AI and analytics skills.
Career: Provide direct access to career pathways in AI and analytics through treks, speaker series, and connections with alumni, founders, investors, and industry leaders.
Community: Foster a collaborative and inclusive community across Wharton, Penn Engineering, and beyond through small-group interactions, mentorship, and cross-school engagement.
Innovation: Create opportunities such as hackathons and project-based initiatives where members can apply their skills to real-world problems and build tangible outcomes.

sports-business.name: Wharton Undergraduate Sports Business Club
sports-business.description:
The Wharton Undergraduate Sports Business Club (WUSBC) was founded in March 2005 after the creation of the Wharton Sports Business Initiative. We are a student group at the University of Pennsylvania dedicated to the dual purpose of spreading information about the sports industry to undergraduates and helping students obtain internships and positions in the field.
Our flagship event is the Wharton Sports Business Summit: an annual conference that we host in the fall. We bring in speakers from around the industry to give presentations to students and professionals. 
Beyond the summit, we host sports quizzo events, fantasy football leagues, and other speaker events. Join the listserv and be informed about these events throughout the semester!
sports-business.how_to_get_involved: WUSBC is compirsed of three committees - The Internal & External, Professional Relations, and a Summit Planning committee. Members can also remain active in the club by being a General Body Member

spec-film-society.name: SPEC Film Society
spec-film-society.description:
SPEC Film Society is a student group at the University of Pennsylvania that hosts free film screenings and other social events. SPEC Film also has an annual speaker series, which in the past has featured famous actors, directors and producers such as Simu Liu, Spike Lee, Sean Baker, Jesse Tyler Ferguson, Joseph Gordon Levitt, Aaron Sorkin, Kenan Thompson, Michael Cera, Woody Harrelson, and others. 
Past Events:
Film Trivia Night 
Various socials 
Movie screenings
spec-film-society.how_to_get_involved: Reach out to us and we'll let you know when our next GBM is! No applications are required to join. If you're passionate about movies and want to bring fun events to the Penn community, SPEC Film is the perfect place for you! Message filmdirs@specevents.net for more info.

womens-club-basketball.name: Women's Club Basketball at Penn
womens-club-basketball.description: Women's Club Basketball at Penn is a student organization at the University of Pennsylvania. The club provides those passionate about basketball with the opportunity to continue playing in college within a competitive and fun environment. Most members played competitive basketball in high school. We travel to a variety of tournaments throughout the year, and we play other collegiate club teams. We also host fundraisers, social events and hope to incorporate some volunteering this coming year!
womens-club-basketball.how_to_get_involved:
****2026-2027 Tryouts Sunday 09/27 4-5:30 in Pottruck and Monday 09/28 8:30-10 in the John R. Rockwell Gymnasium. Both tryouts are mandatory. Follow our instagram for updated information regarding tryouts.****
Send an email to pennclubwbb@gmail.com with any questions!

jhealth-at-penn.name: JHealth
jhealth-at-penn.description:
The Penn Chapter of Olami’s Pre-Health Society is a community of Jewish Undergraduate Pre-Health students, offering career development opportunities so that students can stand out in their respective health fields. We offer access to mentorships, internships, research, graduate school resources, programming, community service, and social events. Open to pre- Medicine, -Dental, -Vet, -OT, -PT, -SLP, Psych, Nursing, Nutrition, Public Health students, and more.
What we offer:
Participate in a weekly Medical Ethics Fellowship series and hear from guest speakers in the medical field
Monthly access to the best professional mentors
Career tips and resources on how to get into medical or grad school
Exclusive access to international trips and summer internship programs (South Africa, Technion JInternship Israel, Birthright, etc.)
Practical application - research and leadership opportunities
Global networking with other Jewish pre-health students
Build your resume to take your career to the next level
Clinical volunteering and community service opportunities
Social events, Shabbat meals, retreats, and more!
Olami JHealth is committed to the growth and success of each individual chapter and student that is involved within the organization. It is JHealth’s goal to provide students with opportunities to learn and grow through both national and local programming. JHealth at Penn is a Student Organization at the University of Pennsylvania.
jhealth-at-penn.how_to_get_involved: Fall 2023: Register with the Penn Chapter here! Please send an email to jhealthpenn@gmail.com and sign up at https://olami.org/jhealth/

upenn-john-marshall-pre-law-honor-societ.name: John Marshall Pre-Law Society at Penn
upenn-john-marshall-pre-law-honor-societ.description: The John Marshall Pre-Law Honor Society (JMS) is a student-run organization that assists Penn undergraduates in their preparation for law school and a legal career. We seek to build a bridge between you, law school students, law school admissions representatives, attorneys, and judges by educating each of our members on what law school is all about, how to apply, and the various career prospects available to law school graduates. Former JMS students have benefitted from their membership in the honor society and gone on to attend top law schools.
upenn-john-marshall-pre-law-honor-societ.how_to_get_involved:
Applications for Spring 2026 HERE 
Applications open for executive board (Internal Chair, Marketing Chair, Website Coordinator), as well as committee and general body members.
You do NOT need to reapply for general membership or committee membership if you are already in the club. 
Follow us on Instagram for more information! @pennprelaw

access-engineering.name: Access Engineering
access-engineering.description: Access Engineering is a free, student-run hands-on engineering enrichment program at the University of Pennsylvania for talented Philadelphia high school students. Our team of passionate undergraduate volunteers makes engineering exciting for a diverse group of ~100 students in a semester-long program on Saturdays. We provide students a hands-on and fun environment to explore what engineering is. Since 2014, Access Engineering has worked to nurture their interest in STEM and develop the Philadelphia Public Schools’ pipeline of future engineers.
access-engineering.how_to_get_involved: Stay tuned for our club application for Fall 2026!

graduate-rowing-and-crew-team.name: Wharton Crew Team
graduate-rowing-and-crew-team.description: Wharton Crew (graduate rowing and crew team) is a student-run rowing team at the University of Pennsylvania dedicated to providing access to rowing opportunities for seasoned, novice, and brand-new rowers! Our mission is to help members develop a passion for this unique sport and get some great exercise while doing it.
graduate-rowing-and-crew-team.how_to_get_involved: Please email us at rowforwharton@gmail.com if you are interested in rowing! Currently open to any Penn graduate students, we are accepting new members for the fall semester with some level of rowing experience. If you have no rowing experience and are still interested, please reach out and let us know, and we'll keep you updated as to when we host learn-to-row events.

penn-ghana.name: Ghanaians at Penn
penn-ghana.description:
We are a student organization at the University of Pennsylvania dedicated to creating a supportive and engaging space for Ghanaians and all members of the Penn community who are interested in learning about Ghanaian culture, identity, and leadership. Our purpose is to provide a platform for Ghanaians to share their experiences and thrive at Penn, while also fostering meaningful conversations about how we can contribute to Ghana’s future as emerging leaders.
Through discussions on the state of affairs in Ghana, mentorship from guest speakers and professionals, and opportunities for cultural exchange, we aim to build a community that not only uplifts Ghanaian students but also invites the wider Penn community to learn, collaborate, and engage. Ultimately, our goal is to establish a network that nurtures leadership, strengthens connections, and contributes to addressing pressing issues in Ghana and beyond.
penn-ghana.how_to_get_involved:
Click the SUBSCRIBE button on our page to be added to our mailing list
OR
Send us an email at pennghana@gmail.com to join our listerv or shoot us a DM on Instagram @pennghana to be added to our GroupMe!

zen-society.name: Zen Society at Penn
zen-society.description: At Zen Society at Penn, our mission is to create a calm, supportive community where students can cultivate inner stability and well-being amid academic intensity and uncertainty. Through meditation, mindfulness practice, and shared reflection, we help members reduce stress and regain clarity in daily life. Grounded in practical, non-sectarian approaches and informed by both Eastern wisdom traditions and modern psychological language, we aim to offer an accessible path for self-understanding, emotional regulation, and meaning-making—so students can live, learn, and make decisions with greater presence, resilience, and purpose.
zen-society.how_to_get_involved:
Feel free to get in touch with us via Slack group:https://join.slack.com/t/zensocietyatpenn/shared_invite/zt-3pic7p946-6hc~PjOQj7RlqMsVhPL1qw, or email: PennZenClub@outlook.com.
As a new club, we are actively planning our upcoming events and looking forward to welcoming new members. 
To learn about what our events look like, please read: https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/CwxFPk3h1V7LJ_OswJd_XA
No prior experience or knowledge of Mandarin required.

penn-undergraduates-for-refugee-empowerm.name: Penn for Refugee Empowerment
penn-undergraduates-for-refugee-empowerm.description:
Penn for Refugee Empowerment (PRE) is a student organization at the University of Pennsylvania. PRE's mission is to empower refugees through education assistance and to foster a welcoming community for refugees to build their own success in Philadelphia.
PRE members engage directly with refugees and support their educational pursuits through tutoring. Volunteer tutors, who have all completed cultural training, offer their services in ESL and a variety of subjects virtually to refugees in Philadelphia and around the world.
Working closely with resettlement centers in Philadelphia, cultural groups on other college campuses, and international organizations, PRE aims to increase awareness of refugee issues and support refugees through advocacy, fundraising, and education.
PRE is a diverse community of human rights- and service-minded individuals who are passionate about making a difference in marginalized people's lives.
penn-undergraduates-for-refugee-empowerm.how_to_get_involved:
Fill out this interest form to get added to our email list and stay updated on our work this semester!
Use this link to join our Group Me to find out about our upcoming events, initiatives, and GBMs.

penn-latin-and-ballroom-dance-plbd.name: Latin and Ballroom Dance (LBD) at Penn
penn-latin-and-ballroom-dance-plbd.description: Latin and Ballroom Dance at Penn is a student organization at the University of Pennsylvania. Our mission is to compete at collegiate ballroom dance competitions, and to teach Latin and ballroom dance at every level - from complete beginner through advanced — so that our members build the skills to compete. We welcome dancers with no prior experience; most of our current competitors started that way!
penn-latin-and-ballroom-dance-plbd.how_to_get_involved: Just show up during activities fair or send us an email!

koreans-at-penn.name: Koreans At Penn (KAP)
koreans-at-penn.description: Koreans At Penn (KAP) is a student organization at the University of Pennsylvania that has been representing the school's Korean population since the late 90s. Comprised mainly of Korean international students, KAP's goal is to learn and educate Korea's rich history and culture, promote camaraderie among its members, and develop relations with other cultural/international communities on campus. With official ties to the Penn Club of Korea, the official regional alumni club approved by the University, KAP connects its members beyond graduation as well. The club and its activities are open to anyone interested in Korea.
koreans-at-penn.how_to_get_involved:
Email kapboard@gmail.com
Signup Form - will be provided very soon (for pre-registration contact email above)

the-christian-association.name: The Christian Association Student Community
the-christian-association.description:
The Christian Association (CA) is a student community of hospitality, service & advocacy, and faith exploration. We are a place where you can bring your questions, find community, and grow in your faith. 
We are open to both undergrad and grad students, and offer a variety of opportunities to gather. Our weekly gathering for dinner and discussion is on Wednesday evenings. We also have at least monthly opportunities for service and social activities. 
We are a ministry that is welcoming and affirming of the LGBTQ+ community. 
We work in collaboration with University Lutheran Church and St. Mary's Episcopal, including offering a contemplative worship service the first Sunday each month.
the-christian-association.how_to_get_involved: Join us for dinner on a Wednesday nights @ 6:30 - beginning Sept. w, and sign up for our listserv to learn more about what's coming up!

society-for-african-internationals-at-pe.name: Society for African Internationals at Penn (SAIP)
society-for-african-internationals-at-pe.description: We are an inclusive community of African international students at the University of Pennsylvania. Our community is dedicated to create space to showcase the beauty of our cultural identities as well as navigating different facets of life in the new environment.

doxa-campus-ministry.name: Doxa Campus Ministry
doxa-campus-ministry.description: Doxa is the college student ministry of Redemption City Church, which exists to promote Christian growth amongst interested students through activities such as Bible studies, corporate prayer and worship, community-building events, and service opportunities. Students from all backgrounds are welcome and will be provided opportunities to explore the Christian faith and connect with mentors from Redemption City Church who will help them navigate life at Penn and beyond.
doxa-campus-ministry.how_to_get_involved: Feel free to email doxacampusministry@gmail.com, DM us on Instagram, or submit a contact form on our website!

penn-blockchain.name: Blockchain at Penn
penn-blockchain.description:
Overview
Blockchain at Penn is the leading undergraduate, graduate, and MBA student organization at the University of Pennsylvania seeking to onboard students to blockchain, crypto, and Web3 landscape. 
We engage with the broader ecosystem via institutional and industry partnerships, which fuel our initiatives in education, strategy, and research. 
Stay up to date via our website, instagram, newsletter, and twitter!
Education and Committees
The Education seminar will be available to all throughout the fall and spring semesters - no knowledge required!
Students participating in committees have access to more club-wide events as well as travel to different blockchain conferences/hackathons domestically and internationally. 
Sign up to our Listerv to stay updated with our recruitment events here: https://mailchi.mp/sas/penn-blockchain-listerv-signup
penn-blockchain.how_to_get_involved: Spring 2026 Applications coming soon! They will be due Friday, January 30th.

womens-club-volleyball.name: Women's Club Volleyball
womens-club-volleyball.description:
The women’s club volleyball team is a competitive club designed for undergraduate/graduate women at the University of Pennsylvania who played volleyball at the varsity and/or club level in high school and wish to continue playing competitively. The club atmosphere is not as rigorous as varsity college sports, but it is significantly more competitive than intramural teams.
Our season runs from September to May and includes two 2-hour practices per week (three during tournament weeks), 3–4 single-day tournaments each semester, and the annual 3-day National Tournament in April.
womens-club-volleyball.how_to_get_involved:
2026-2027 Club Season Tryout Schedule: 
Tryout #1: TBD Early September @Rockwell Gym
Tryout #2: TBD Early September @Rockwell Gym (callback required)
If you’re interested in trying out for our club, please complete the form below to receive updates and tryout information for the 2025–2026 season: https://forms.gle/ZmLUK7Crow188nnf8 
Stay up to date by following our instagram!

penn-womens-club-soccer.name: Women’s Club Soccer at Penn
penn-womens-club-soccer.description: Women's Club Soccer is a sport club at the University of Pennsylvania dedicated to playing soccer at a highly competitive level with a manageable time commitment. We practice twice a week and have games on the weekends, either away at regional schools (e.g., Drexel, Villanova, TCNJ) or home at Penn Park. Though our primary season takes place in the fall, we practice throughout the year and have outdoor friendly matches in the spring as well. Last year, our team finished regular season play at the top of our divisional league, going undefeated. We additionally have the opportunity to play in regional and national tournaments, and we travelled to compete at the NIRSA Club Soccer Championships in both 2021 and 2022 and Regional Tournaments in 2023 and 2024. We are coming off a strong result in 2024, but we are looking forward to finish even better this fall.
penn-womens-club-soccer.how_to_get_involved: Please check out our instagram (@upennwclubsoccer) for more information, and contact the captains with any questions!

wharton-energy-conference.name: Wharton Energy Conference
wharton-energy-conference.description: Since 2004, the Wharton Energy Conference has been bringing students and professionals from Philadelphia and across the country together to discuss trends and changes in the energy industry. Topics covered include renewable energy, energy finance, and business innovations that are changing the energy landscape. We convene typically around 300 attendees annually.
wharton-energy-conference.how_to_get_involved: Involvement in the Wharton Energy Conference is intended for graduate and MBA students, but we also accept undergraduates as members.

penn-medina.name: Black Muslims at Penn
penn-medina.description: Black Muslims at Penn aims to create an inclusive, welcoming, and supportive community that fosters connection and growth among Black Muslim students at Penn and other universities. Our mission is to promote unity and understanding across different backgrounds within the African Diaspora, expand our Islamic knowledge while fostering an environment of mutual respect, and collaboration, and emphasizing the Islamic principles of community, charity, and service. We strive to build meaningful relationships, empower our members, and create opportunities for personal and collective growth, ensuring all Black Muslims at Penn feel valued, connected, and supported. Penn Medina is open to all undergraduate and graduate students.
penn-medina.how_to_get_involved:
Follow us on Instagram, Facebook and join our GroupMe. 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/medinatpenn/
GroupMe: https://groupme.com/join_group/104696793/MFkHo06E 
Information regarding board applications will be posted on Instagram.

ipdga.name: Integrated Product Design Student Graduate Association (IPDGA)
ipdga.description: IPDGA is a student group at the University of Pennsylvania. We aim to serve the needs of the entire IPD student body and act as a key liason between IPD students and faculty. Our many committees target the social, academic, and professional needs of IPD student.s
ipdga.how_to_get_involved: Must be a current IPD student to get involved. Please reach out to IPDGA Co-Presidents Inesh (patra10@seas.upenn.edu )and Wendy ( woduor01@engineering.upenn.edu) for more information!

wharton-muslims-in-business.name: Wharton Muslims in Business

mathmates.name: MathMates
mathmates.description: Supported by the Netter Center for Community Partnerships, MathMates is a student group at the University of Pennsylvania that provides math tutoring for middle school students at Andrew Hamilton School in West Philadelphia. Penn student tutors build relationships with students, teach math concepts, learn about the qualities of effective tutoring, and facilitate interactive games.
mathmates.how_to_get_involved:
Apply here by Tuesday, September 8th at 11:59pm: 
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfrPynBfomIUhZd0EziygFaDJ8wL7AzGcKTeNxbeQwyRECMnA/viewform?usp=publish-editor

chi-alpha-upenn.name: CCC College Ministry
chi-alpha-upenn.description: CCC College Ministry is a diverse college student community group at the University of Pennsylvania pursuing Jesus Christ, growing in faith, building real relationships, and living out God’s purpose on campus and beyond.
chi-alpha-upenn.how_to_get_involved: Email us or join our mailing list!

peruvian.name: Peruvian Student Association
peruvian.description: The Peruvian Student Association at the University of Pennsylvania, also known as Peru@Penn, seeks to promote, represent and celebrate Peruvian culture both on and off campus, creating an inclusive space that unites students from Peru, the Peruvian diaspora, and anyone interested in our history and traditions. Our mission is to foster cultural pride, learning and exchange through social and artistic activities that strengthen the bonds between the Peruvian students and the Penn environment. We also aim to serve as a bridge between students, alumni and the Peruvian community in Philadelphia.

malaysians-at-penn.name: Malaysians at Penn
malaysians-at-penn.description: M@P is a group for anyone at Penn who wants to mingle, share a safe space, and support each other — with a special love for Malaysian culture and community. Everyone’s welcome to join, whether you’re Malaysian or just interested in making new friends. We will be enjoying a great time together through fun games and gatherings!
malaysians-at-penn.how_to_get_involved: DM us on Instagram or email us to join our Whatsapp Group!

spec-concerts.name: SPEC Concerts
spec-concerts.description:
SPEC Concerts is a student group that organizes Penn's Annual Spring Fling Concert!
Our renowned Spring Fling Concert has comprised of illustrious acts that include Metro Boomin', Daya, Jay Sean, Lauv, Lil TJay, Flo Milli, Lil Yatchy, Cheat Codes, Tiesto, David Guetta, Chance The Rapper, Gryffin, Louis the Child, Zedd, Kygo, Chloe x Halle, Passion Pit, Janelle Monae, Lupe Fiasco, Rina Sawayama, Wale, WizKid, Flo Rida, Snoop Dogg, Kid Cudi, Akon, Ludacris, Gym Class Heroes, Third Eye Blind, The Roots, The Black-Eyed Peas, Cherub, Hall and Oates, Tinashe, JoJo, and countless others.
spec-concerts.how_to_get_involved: Pop in to our weekly and biweekly meetings and follow us on Instagram @specconcerts!!

upenn-equestrian-club.name: Penn Equestrian Team
upenn-equestrian-club.description: The Penn Equestrian Team is a student group at the University of Pennsylvania comprised of riders who compete in the IHSA or ride recreationally. Riders come from all different backgrounds and varying level of experiences. All Penn students are welcome to join the team!
upenn-equestrian-club.how_to_get_involved: Send us an email or visit our website!

reading-initiative.name: Penn Reading Initiative
reading-initiative.description: Penn Reading Initiative's mission is to utilize sociolinguistic knowledge in promoting literacy in West Philadelphia schools as part of the Netter Center.
reading-initiative.how_to_get_involved: To join PRI for the Fall Semester, please fill out this link: https://forms.gle/jsRcnewiM4r6jTNR9

melsa.name: Middle Eastern Law Student Association (MELSA)
melsa.description: The Middle Eastern Law Student Association (MELSA) fosters community among Penn Carey Law students interested in the Middle East and North Africa and related diasporas. MELSA promotes cultural understanding, thoughtful dialogue, and professional development through social, educational, and networking programming. The organization aims to support its members, celebrate the diversity of Middle Eastern identities and experiences, and contribute to a more inclusive law school community.
melsa.how_to_get_involved: Email melsa.penn@gmail.com to join our mailing list, hear about upcoming events, and learn about opportunities to get involved.

doctores-hispanos-del-futuro-penn.name: Doctores Hispanos Del Futuro @PENN/LMSA+
doctores-hispanos-del-futuro-penn.description:
Welcome to DOCTORES HISPANOS DEL FUTURO @PENN/Latino Medical Student Association (LMSA) Pre-Health Latina/o/x Undergraduate Society (PLUS) Chapter.
This is vibrant and inclusive community dedicated to fostering the next generation of Hispanic healthcare professionals at the University of Pennsylvania! Our club is a space where aspiring doctors, nurses, researchers, and healthcare enthusiasts of Hispanic/Latinx descent come together to share their passion for medicine, collaborate on meaningful projects, and support one another on the journey towards a rewarding career in healthcare.
Open to all students at the University of Pennsylvania who have an interest in healthcare and a passion for promoting diversity and inclusion in the medical field. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds and experiences.
¡Bienvenidos a DOCTORES HISPANOS DEL FUTURO @PENN+!
For more info contact:
penn.doctoreshdfuturo@gmail.com

Penncasila.name: Indonesian Student Association at Penn
Penncasila.description: Founded in 2017 and formerly known as Penncasila, ISAP is the University of Pennsylvania’s Indonesian student association. We are a warm and welcoming community of students passionate about sharing Indonesian culture with the Penn community. We welcome all Penn students interested in learning about and celebrating Indonesian culture. Come join us and be part of our community!
Penncasila.how_to_get_involved: A member simply has to sign up for our listserv, come to our events, or indicate an interest in being a part of Penncasila to be considered part of the family.

bgsa.name: Biomedical Graduate Student Association (BGSA)
bgsa.description: The Biomedical Graduate Student Association (BGSA) is the coordinating student body charged with representing all students enrolled in the Biomedical Graduate Studies program at the University of Pennsylvania. We monitor issues of importance to the biomedical graduate students and Master's & Certificate programs student community, represent the concerns of biomedical graduate students to the University administration, and advocate for changes to enhance the quality of biomedical graduate education. We also serve as a liaison among the student populations of the biomedical graduate programs and sponsor both academic and social events of interest to the biomedical graduate student and Master's & Certificate student community.
bgsa.how_to_get_involved: If you are a student in Biomedical Graduate Studies (including PhD and Masters & Certificate students), you are already considered a general member of BGSA. If you are interested in becoming a member of the BGSA Executive Board or a BGSA Representative to GAPSA,=, nominations and elections for many positions occur in the Spring semester, and some elections additionally occur in the Fall semester.

penn-sikh-organization.name: Sikh Organization of Penn
penn-sikh-organization.description: Sikh Organization of Penn aims to spread awareness of the Sikh heritage and culture at the University of Pennsylvania and in the city of Philadelphia. This inclusive, student-run organization holds various social, cultural, and community service events on and off campus to promote the Sikh culture.
penn-sikh-organization.how_to_get_involved: Please email sikhorgofpenn@gmail.com if you are interested in joining!

international-student-athletes-associati.name: International Student-Athlete Association
international-student-athletes-associati.description: The International Student-Athlete Association at the University of Pennsylvania is dedicated to fostering a welcoming, inclusive, and supportive community for all Penn students interested in global perspectives through sport and culture. Our mission is to bridge cultural gaps, promote academic and athletic collaboration, and support personal and professional growth. We aim to enhance the university experience by offering resources, advocacy, and programs that celebrate diversity, promote well-being, and encourage cross-cultural understanding within the Penn community.
international-student-athletes-associati.how_to_get_involved: email gabbyj@sas.upenn.edu with your preferred email and phone number to be added to the email list and groupchat so you stay up to date with events!

weitzman-gardeners.name: Weitzman Gardeners
weitzman-gardeners.description: We believe in the transformative potential of gardens both within the design of public spaces and individual’s lives. The club strives to provide experiential learning for Weitzman students with the earth outside the classroom, and create a forum to connect and explore our interest in the many facets of gardening. By identifying and working with campus and other local partners, we aim to use gardening as a way to get our hands in the dirt and improve the greater community.
weitzman-gardeners.how_to_get_involved:
Membership of the club is limited to currently enrolled students within the Weitzman School of Design. The Leadership Team may approve other memberships on a case-by-case basis. Club events are open to students, faculty, staff, and others within the Weitzman School of Design community.
To get involved, come to a club event or fill out our interest form linked on our Instagram!

phi-gamma-nu-professional-business-frate.name: Phi Gamma Nu (PGN) Professional Business Fraternity
phi-gamma-nu-professional-business-frate.description:
Phi Gamma Nu is a student group at the University of Pennsylvania that proudly upholds Three National Pillars which represent the underlying ideals of the fraternity.
Through Professionalism, Phi Gamma Nu seeks to constantly spread interest in the business field throughout college campuses. To this end, the National Board promotes the chapters' organization of creative professional events. 
Through Philanthropy, Phi Gamma Nu chapters are able to build strong bonds with their respective communities as well. As the fraternity's brothers believe in civic responsibility, chapters nationwide organize and participate in community outreach events. 
Through Community, Phi Gamma Nu believes in upholding the interest of our Alma Maters through the encouragement of high scholarship, participation in school activities, and awareness of important issues and current events on and around campus.
We believe that by fostering professionalism, service, and community, we can develop a group of PGN brothers well prepared for future endeavors.
phi-gamma-nu-professional-business-frate.how_to_get_involved: Visit our website (https://www.pgnupenn.org/) or Facebook page (PGN at the University of Pennsylvania) for information about our recruitment process. Reach out to upenn.pgn.recruitment@gmail.com with any questions.

nsbe.name: National Society of Black Engineers (NSBE)
nsbe.description: NSBE is an organization dedicated to supporting the academic and professional success of STEM students. We host a wide variety of events, including professional development workshops and exclusive networking sessions with corporate partners like Google, Bloomberg, Visa, Johnson & Johnson, etc. We also provide the opportunity to get to know engineers across all STEM majors and grade levels. Plus, we always provide free food at our events!
nsbe.how_to_get_involved:
Follow us on IG!
https://www.instagram.com/upenn.nsbe/ 
Join our listserv using the link below!
https://facebook.us19.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=54a9737452470a5f9e24fdfe6&id=ab9a4ef731 
Join our Slack!
https://join.slack.com/t/nsbe2026-27/shared_invite/zt-47ry4hjol-d~bENgrnFo5gFXXrOESEKQ

penn-rubiks-cube-club.name: Cubing at Penn
penn-rubiks-cube-club.description: Cubing at Penn is a student group at the University of Pennsylvania. We cube both competitively and casually. You can absolutely join us with no cubing background to learn and become a fantastic cuber!
penn-rubiks-cube-club.how_to_get_involved: Fill out this interest form (https://forms.gle/NbtjjnQkAv9LZVpN6 ) to join us! Open membership, no application needed to be a member. We will meetly roughly once a week on Sundays. You are welcome as long as you love cubing, just like us all!

hackers-at-penn.name: Hackers at Penn
hackers-at-penn.description: We are a student organization, permissioned by the Office of Student Affairs at the University of Pennsylvania to provide project based skill building opportunities. Hackers at Penn's mission is to deliver active based learning and social skills building opportunities through organizing Hackathon events. Our goal is to provide our member students the opportunities to develop intangible skills, build their social network by improving their networking opportunities, and promote project based learning through collaboration efforts with their peers.
hackers-at-penn.how_to_get_involved: Fill out our application. The application gives us a chance to learn more about you and your goals. We will contact you on the next steps on how to get involved after processing and reviewing your application.

wharton-israel-club.name: Wharton Israel Club
wharton-israel-club.description: The Wharton Israel Club connects the Wharton community with Israel's business and innovation ecosystem. We bring students together with Israeli founders, investors, and business leaders through our flagship Wharton Israel Innovation Conference in New York, the annual Israel Trek, speaker events, and social and cultural gatherings. Whether you're Israeli or have never been to Israel, everyone is welcome.
wharton-israel-club.how_to_get_involved: Come to our events, including the Israel Innovation Conference, the Israel Trek, speaker sessions, and social gatherings throughout the year, and join the club on Wharton Groups. Questions? Email igal@wharton.upenn.edu.

pennsori.name: PennSori A Cappella
pennsori.description: PennSori is the premier Korean A Cappella Student Group at the University of Pennsylvania. We perform a mix of Korean and American songs of all genres (K-Pop, K-RnB, K-Ballad, K-HipHop, jazz, rock, pop, etc.) in order to serve as a cultural bridge between Korean and American cultures. We welcome students of any and all cultural backgrounds! Fluency in Korean is not at all required.

united-minorities-council.name: United Minorities Council (UMC)
united-minorities-council.description:
The United Minorities Council was founded in 1978 as an intercultural coalition of students who fight for equity and access to resources at Penn. Among UMC’s earliest accomplishments is staging sit-in protests that led to the establishment of the Greenfield Intercultural Center.
Today, the UMC represents over 40 student groups that serve a variety of cultural communities. We provide funding for their events as well as hold our own events. The UMC has 2 primary goals: to foster intercultural understanding and solidarity within the student body and to fight for better resources from the University. We work closely with the other 7B groups to pursue these goals, and meet with Penn’s administration (including the Vice Provost Office, President, and Admissions) multiple times per semester. Ultimately, UMC serves as a bridge between the student body and the University in order to advocate for the needs of its underrepresented students.
united-minorities-council.how_to_get_involved:
For students who want to get involved, UMC holds monthly General Body Meetings that anyone is welcome to attend. Constituents are required to attend these meetings to be elligible for UMC funding. Further information on GBMs will be available throughout the semester. 
If you're a student group interested in becoming a UMC Constituent, check out our Instagram, which includes the most up-to-date information regarding becoming a Constituent.

first-love-phily.name: Ready@20
first-love-phily.description:
Ready@20 is a student organization committed to bring the youth together and help them establish their walk in Christ alongside other believers. 
affiliated with https://www.firstlovecenter.com
first-love-phily.how_to_get_involved: Come to weekly meeting, invite others, and be involved.

spec-pop-up.name: SPEC Pop Up
spec-pop-up.description: We plan and host a variety of free spontaneous giveaways, events, and activities throughout the year for students to enjoy a break from classes! We are a student-run committee within student government at the University of Pennsylvania.
spec-pop-up.how_to_get_involved: Check out UPenn SPEC's Instagram and join our GroupMe at https://groupme.com/join_group/89185619/Tvxg1Phv to learn more about when our GBMs are!

fgli-podcast.name: FGLI Podcast
fgli-podcast.description: We are a student-run podcast at the University of Pennsylvania. The goal of this podcast is to celebrate and highlight different FGLI stories while facilitating discourse around the challenges and unique experiences of growing up FGLI.
fgli-podcast.how_to_get_involved: Please follow our Instagram page (@fglipodcast) for upcoming information on applying to our team.

the-andean-representation.name: The Andean Representation
the-andean-representation.description: Andean Representation is an organization designed for the spread, advancement, and acknowledgment of Andean culture at the University of Pennsylvania. We are an all-inclusive organization aiming to provide a unique space for students identifying as Andean as well as those interested in Andean culture. Our focus is to facilitate cultural, academic, and social events relevant to the countries of the Andes region, including, but not limited to, Ecuador, Peru, Bolivia, Venezuela, Colombia, Argentina and Chile. In addition to club-specific programming, we work closely with the Quechua at Penn language program to sponsor events that highlight the beauty and importance of our indigenous culture found within our broader Andean community.
the-andean-representation.how_to_get_involved: Please fill out this form if interested in joining our club for the 2026-2027 academic school year! https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdvxkltxSOwI_oNzl1ixzUyYYDdIIVTVXJc_S7WYrTPOAdgqA/viewform

pensapenn.name: The Glory Guild
pensapenn.description:
The Glory Guild is a student-run Christian club at the University of Pennsylvania dedicated to reflecting the glory of God. We seek to build a family through Bible studies, prayer meetings, fasting, outreach, and fellowship—cultivating community while building disciples one student at a time. Our mission is to live practically as Christians and reflect the glory of God as His image-bearers. Through these practices, we will deepen our faith through His love and the power and guidance of the Holy Spirit.
The name The Glory Guild stems from the overarching purpose of coming together to bring glory to the Lord. We live in this truth of 1 Peter 2:9: “But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for his own possession, that you may proclaim the excellencies of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.” 
All are welcome to learn about Jesus!
pensapenn.how_to_get_involved: Follow us on Instagram to be updated on announcements and events and just show up!

wharton-asian-american-assocation-of-mba.name: Wharton Asian American Assocation of MBAs (WAAAM)
wharton-asian-american-assocation-of-mba.description:
Wharton Asian American Association of MBAs (WAAAM) provides a forum for celebrating all AAPI identities while supporting members professionally, academically, and socially at Wharton and beyond. You do not need to be Asian or American to join WAAAM – we're proud to welcome all allies and supporters of our mission!
Our Pillars:
Community: Events to foster intimate spaces of meaningful connection for members of the WAAAM community to share and learn.
Identity: Promote self-reflection and dialogue on topics related to AAPI identity and matters impacting the AAPI community. 
Partnerships: Facilitate connections to the broader Wharton MBA community via event collaborations with other affinity & recreational student organizations.
Empowerment: Support members in recruitment and empower them to lead AAPI advancement in the workforce.
Social: Plan and host large-scale, engaging events that create and strengthen bonds among WAAAM members and the broader Wharton community.

penn-taekwondo-club-itf.name: Taekwondo Club (ITF)
penn-taekwondo-club-itf.description: Tae Kwon Do Club (ITF) at the University of Pennsylvania is one of the oldest student martial arts groups at Penn, founded by a (then) medical student, Anthony D'Amico in 1985. It is currently led by several of his students, black belts and master black belts, who continue to offer Penn students, Tae Kwon Do in a traditional setting which emphasizes both mental and physical conditioning. Classes are available to students three times a week, and are intended to challenge the body physically through aerobic and muscular conditioning while using the energy generated to create a better awareness of mental focus and control. Students are encouraged to apply this deeper focus and awareness both inside and outside the training room - into their campus experience. Through the mastering of forms and techniques, Tae Kwon Do encourages individual growth and enlightenment within a NON-competitve environment.
penn-taekwondo-club-itf.how_to_get_involved: Email us (info@upenntkd.org) to find out more, or come to an open class.

hillel-soup-kitchen.name: Hillel Soup Kitchen
hillel-soup-kitchen.description:
The club is open to all interested volunteers, who will package snacks, serve hot meals, and make connections with our guests. We meet every Sunday from 5:15-6:30 pm, in the Hillel lobby. 
The Penn Hillel Soup Kitchen is part of the University City Hospitality Coalition, which runs soup kitchens throughout Philadelphia to serve local community members.

penn-model-congress.name: Model Congress at Penn
penn-model-congress.description: Model Congress at Penn, founded in 1997, is an entirely student-run organization open to all undergraduates of the University of Pennsylvania. Each spring, Model Congress at Penn hosts an elite four-day conference for high school students from around the country to debate bills written by their peers covering a variety of contemporary political issues. Additionally, the club sponsors panels, guest speakers, and various other events in order to discuss and enhance our understanding of the United States government, particularly the Congress and legislative process.
penn-model-congress.how_to_get_involved: More information coming soon on open board positions. Even if you are not given an appointed position, all are welcome to serve as commitee chairs (judges) at our high school conference. If you would like to be added to our listserv, please fill out this form . Feel free to reach out to our President, Victor Han, at vhan@sas.upenn.edu or conference@pennmc.org with any questions.

penn-arab-student-society.name: Arab Student Society
penn-arab-student-society.description:
The Arab Student Society at the University of Pennsylvania is a student-run organization geared towards fostering Arab culture and heritage on campus. We host cultural and social events that celebrate and share Arab culture with the entire Penn community. Through our Big-Little Program, dining events, and more programming coming this semester, we hope to strengthen the Arab/Arab-interested community that we've built here at Penn.
To become a member, all you have to do is attend our events and be active within the community; all backgrounds are welcome!
penn-arab-student-society.how_to_get_involved:
Attend any of our events! Everyone is welcome! All events will be advertised on Instagram.
If you are interested in becoming a board member, keep an eye out for applications at the end of the fall semester!

1st-year-at-penn.name: Muslim Law Students Association (MLSA)
1st-year-at-penn.description: MLSA welcomes the participation of all members of the Penn Law community and encourages the presence of Muslims from diverse schools of thought, levels of faith and backgrounds. MLSA hopes to foster a welcoming atmosphere for every law student wishing to learn more about Islam and/or gain support from their community.

intervarsity-christian-fellowship.name: InterVarsity Christian Fellowship
intervarsity-christian-fellowship.description: InterVarsity Christian Fellowship at University of Pennsylvania is an interdenominational student group committed to following Jesus Christ and cultivating a welcoming community where students explore scripture, grow in faith, and live out God’s love on campus and beyond.
intervarsity-christian-fellowship.how_to_get_involved:
Contact us: upennintervarsity@gmail.com, wolf07@nursing.upenn.edu
DM us: @upennintervarsity
Website: https://linktr.ee/UPennInterVarsity?utm_source=linktree_profile_share&ltsid=eeefab9e-48dc-44d1-b6f8-9824eccc41bb

penntorship-dental.name: Penntorship (Dental)
penntorship-dental.description: Serving West Philadelphia's youth through academic enrichment, career exploration, and oral health education.
penntorship-dental.how_to_get_involved: If you'd like to get involved, please join our GroupMe for club updates and details: https://groupme.com/join_group/103358346/OadnaOwP

penn-game-day.name: GameDay at Penn
penn-game-day.description: GameDay at Penn seeks to bring individuals from all over the Penn community together to watch the biggest games/tournaments in sports across various locations on campus. While this club is primarily intended for leisure, it also serves to form new friendships among strangers who share a love for watching sports or simply want to meet new people!

simply-chaos.name: Simply Chaos
simply-chaos.description: Simply Chaos is the University of Pennsylvania’s first and only stand-up student-run comedy collective. We perform at events around Philadelphia, sponsored campus events, and produce our own show every semester.
simply-chaos.how_to_get_involved: Our auditions for the Fall Semester are taking place on September 6th in Platt House. We will be sending out the form to sign up during the first week of the semester. We will also be on Locust Walk with QR codes if you'd like to sign up there. If you'd like more information, feel free to email us at the listed email address, or message us on Facebook under "Simply Chaos" or instagram @pennsimplychaos

istmo-y-vos.name: Istmo Y Vos
istmo-y-vos.description: Central America is politically, culturally, and economically significant both as a region and on a global scale. As Central American identifying students at the University of Pennsylvania and in the U.S.A., it is crucial to remember the countries that influence our lives, culturally and socially. We believe it is important for there to be representation of our diverse cultures, Istmo y Vos, or I.Vos, aims to help students who identify or are interested in Central America to have a space to discuss, share, and convivir juntos.

penn-black-scientist-collective.name: The Black Scientist Collective
penn-black-scientist-collective.description: Black Scientist Collective (BSC) is a student organization at the University of Pennsylvania dedicated to fostering community and opportunities for Black students across pre-health and STEM disciplines within the university and the wider Philadelphia area. Our mission is to unite Black scientific minds on campus while empowering members to excel academically, professionally, and clinically. Through a range of activities such as faculty and graduate mentorship, research panels, skill-building workshops, community service, and professional networking, we aim to equip our members to pursue academic excellence and personal success while championing health equity and diversity in science. Membership is open to all enrolled students at the University of Pennsylvania, regardless of background. BSC supports and abides by Penn’s Nondiscrimination Statement.

nutrition-advocacy.name: Nutrition and Advocacy Partners at Penn
nutrition-advocacy.description: NAPP is a student-led organization through the School of Nursing dedicated to applying nutrition science to clinical practice, preventive health, and everyday well-being. NAPP fosters interdisciplinary learning, hands-on experiences, and peer connection, helping nursing and pre-health students translate classroom knowledge into real-world health advocacy. Through workshops, community engagement (volunteering), and a focus on accessible nutrition, NAPP promotes whole-person care and advances health equity.

future-practice-owners.name: Future Practice Owners
future-practice-owners.description:
Help dental students at UPenn develop the business acumen, technical skills, and ethical standards needed to run a successful future dental practice
Collaborate with successful faculty, alumni, and local clinicians running dental practices
Educate students on options for equipment, software, and other necessary back-office functions

penn-undergraduate-moot-court-team.name: Undergraduate Moot Court at Penn
penn-undergraduate-moot-court-team.description: We are a student group at the University of Pennsylvania that participates in the American Moot Court Association regional competitions. Moot court gives students a taste of how appellate advocacy works. Students will learn how to write 19-30 page legal briefs utilizing real case law and legal citations. Students will also be prepared to present oral arguments in front of real attorneys and sitting judges at regional competitions. This pre-law activity not only prepares students for an important law school activity, but also gives students the opportunity to develop their critical writing and logic skills, as well as how to think on the fly through tough questioning on oral arguments.

kurdish-students-at-penn.name: Kurdish Students at Penn
kurdish-students-at-penn.description: Our mission is to celebrate and share Kurdish culture at the University of Pennsylvania through language, music, dance, and traditions. We welcome all Penn students—regardless of heritage or background—to participate in our community, learn about Kurdish history, and engage in meaningful cultural exchange. Through cultural gatherings, academic discussions, and social events, we aim to amplify Kurdish voices and foster understanding across the broader Penn community.

langfitt.name: Langfitt Neurosurgical Society
langfitt.description: The Langfitt Neurosurgical Society is dedicated to providing a community for medical students at the University of Pennsylvania interested in neurosurgery. The primary mission of the Society is to promote interest, education, research, clinical experience, networking, and peer mentorship in the field of neurosurgery. The Society aims to offer tailored programming and mentorship opportunities specific to neurosurgery, distinct from other surgical interest groups, to support students pursuing careers in this specialized field.
langfitt.how_to_get_involved:
Eligibility: Membership is open to any medical student at the University of Pennsylvania interested in learning about neurosurgery. No prior experience or knowledge of neurosurgery is required.
Recruitment Process: General membership requires no application or screening process. Interested students may join by attending meetings or events.Membership 
Expectations: Members are encouraged to actively participate in Society events, including general body meetings, educational workshops, research initiatives, and mentorship programs. However, there are no formal requirements for general membership.

latinx.name: Latinx Coalition
latinx.description: The Latinx Coalition is the umbrella organization for all Latinx student organizations at the University of Pennsylvania. The LC was originally formed in 1992 and was created to unify the Latinx community. This student organization represents the Latinx community on administrative levels and coordinates community events.
latinx.how_to_get_involved: The LC Board is reelected at the end of every fall semester and their term period begins the following spring semester.

fine-arts-design.name: Fine Arts & Design
