fine-arts-design.description: FAD is the Fine Arts and Design student board where we put on extracurricular art and design events in Addams – screenprinting, exhibitions, flea markets – whatever feels exciting and fun. We welcome all who are artists and/or willing to learn more about the art world.

penn-carey-law-veterans-club.name: Penn Carey Law Veterans Club
penn-carey-law-veterans-club.description: The mission of Penn Carey Law Veterans is to promote military veteran recruiting, retention of military veteran admitted students, and advancement of veteran interests at Penn Carey Law. The group will also provide opportunities for veteran fellowship and advancement, organize veteran recruitment events, and provide a single voice to the staff and faculty for veteran specific issues.

wharton-femtech-club.name: Wharton FemTech Club
wharton-femtech-club.description: The Wharton Femtech Club's mission is to build a community dedicated to learning, exploring, and pursuing professional opportunities in the femtech (female health and wellness) space.

entrepreneurship-club.name: Entrepreneurship Club
entrepreneurship-club.description: Fostering an entrepreneurial ecosystem for Wharton MBA students.

dancemovement-grad-lab.name: Dance+Movement Grad Lab
dancemovement-grad-lab.description:
These sessions will invite graduate students to move and get back into their bodies through short warm-up and training sessions in classical and contemporary dance techniques, followed by exploratory and creative tasks. 
 The aim of this club is to open the space for aural and kinetic means of communication, as well as exploring other sensorial ways of thinking, within a fun, relaxed, and inquisitive movement training opportunity. 
 Anyone interested in finding balance between desk work, mindfulness, screen time, and creativity through movement is welcomed!
dancemovement-grad-lab.how_to_get_involved:
"Dance+Movement Grad Lab" is a Graduate Student Club offering contemporary-ballet training followed by exploratory movement analysis sessions to create collaborative and experimental ideas in motion. Join the movement: breath, destress, vent, smile, and groove with us! 
Any questions, feel free to contact Gema (she/her/ella) at gemavt@sas.upenn.edu or visit our IG @dancemovtlabupenn

penn-enchord-a-cappella.name: EnChord A Cappella
penn-enchord-a-cappella.description:
Founded in 2013, Enchord is the premier Chinese-Western fusion a cappella singing group at the University of Pennsylvania. Its members come from student bodies of both the undergraduate and graduate schools of Penn and from beyond the Penn community.
We host a concert every semester and sometimes are invited to perform at events held by other clubs and organizations. We make our original a cappella arrangements for most of the songs we sing and the audience have enjoyed them during the concert. We mostly sing in Chinese and English but sometimes we also sing songs in other languages such as Japanese and Spanish.

brazil-club.name: Brazil Club at Penn
brazil-club.description: The Brazil Club (PBC) is an organized student group at the University of Pennsylvania created to promote Brazilian culture within the university community. The club meets throughout the semester for a variety of fun cultural events.

wharton-pub.name: Wharton MBA Pub
wharton-pub.description:
Wharton MBA Pub is a 30+ year tradition whose goal is to bring the MBA community together each week over food and drinks. Through a variety of
programmed and co-hosted events, we celebrate the best of the MBA program and provide a space to unwind after the week, mingle across classes, and form
deeper connections with students, professors and alumni.

penn-paraguayan-association.name: Paraguayans at Penn
penn-paraguayan-association.description: Mba'éichapa! We're a community of undergraduate and graduate Paraguayan students at Penn. We meet regularly to cure the techaga'u while enjoying some good food and conversations. Send us an email if you want to join us!

upstream.name: Upstream
upstream.description: Upstream is a publishing collective based in Lenapehoking (so-called Philadelphia), formed through a shared desire for cross-disciplinary exchange, collective study, and peer support. We gather to notice, question, and map the dynamic ecologies between people, the built environment, and our nonhuman relatives. Upstream is a graduate student group at the University of Pennsylvania. Our work takes form through workshops, editing, experimental print and digital publications, and in-person gatherings rooted in slow collaboration. Over the past year, we have collaborated with artists, writers, and researchers on our inaugural theme, Source, which resists linear origin stories in favor of nonlinear, sedimented paths shaped by movement, extraction, memory, and repair. Through participatory workshops and collective making, we approach publishing as a social and aesthetic practice that cultivates attention, relation, and shared meaning

penn-carey-law-real-estate-club.name: Penn Carey Law Real Estate Club
penn-carey-law-real-estate-club.description: The Penn Carey Law Real Estate Club works in conjunction with Wharton’s Zell & Laurie Real Estate center to provide an opportunity for law students interested in the real estate industry to participate in meetings, panel discussions and informal activities with students, academics and business professionals who share a passion for real estate. Law students in the Penn Carey Law Real Estate club are given the chance to meet with some of the biggest names in the industry and develop a one-on-one rapport with active professionals though the Zell & Laurie mentorship program.
penn-carey-law-real-estate-club.how_to_get_involved: Students email dkiraj@penncareylaw.upenn.edu or anjali29@penncareylaw.upenn.edu to be added to the email list

latter-day-saint-student-association.name: Latter-day Saint Student Association
latter-day-saint-student-association.description: The official student organization to promote spiritual well-being and community among students of the University of Pennsylvania who are members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints and their peers. All are welcome.
latter-day-saint-student-association.how_to_get_involved: Reach out! Everyone is welcome to attend our activities!

immigration-and-asylum-law-club.name: Immigration and Asylum Law Club
immigration-and-asylum-law-club.description: IALC seeks to serve as the academic, professional, and social hub for immigration law at Penn Law, pulling together students from across the law school interested in or passionate about immigration, asylum, and refugee law.

philadelphia-oral-care-cancer-5kwalk.name: Philadelphia Oral Cancer Walk/5K
philadelphia-oral-care-cancer-5kwalk.description: The Philadelphia Oral Cancer Walk & 5K has been an annual tradition at Penn Dental Medicine since 2009 created and organized entirely by students. Our mission is to raise awareness about oral cancer and raise money for the PDM Oral Cancer fund, which supports oral cancer research.

2029-class-board.name: 2029 Class Board
2029-class-board.description: Serving to connect, support, and unite the Class of 2029 through engaging events and traditions! We want to help foster a memorable time at Penn for our class! The 2029 Class Board is a branch of student government at the University of Pennsylvania!

thai-students-association.name: Thai Students Association at Penn
thai-students-association.description:
Thai Student Association at the University of Pennsylvania, also more affectionately and unofficially known as PennThai was founded in 1995. The association now comprise more than 40 undergraduate and graduate students, both Thai and non-Thai, who are interested to learn more about our heritage.
Over the years, we have become a more active student group on campus, organizing a plethora of events for our members and the Penn community, ranging from small gatherings to our signature extravaganza, Thai Night! As a member of the Asian Pacific Student Coalition (APSC), PennThai also works with other cultural groups on campus to celebrate and promote the richness of Asian Pacific American culture. It is our hope to continue to build a close-knit Thai community and to establish good relationships with other cultural groups through these events.

penn-med-symphony-orchestra.name: Penn Medicine Symphony Orchestra
penn-med-symphony-orchestra.description: Penn Medicine Symphony Orchestra is an orchestra for students affiliated with the health sciences. We are open to all skill levels and experiences, and our mission is to provide an opportunity for members of the Penn Medicine community to remain involved with music.
penn-med-symphony-orchestra.how_to_get_involved: Please submit a form through https://www.pennmedsymphony.com/join if you are interested in joining us or would like more information!

hispanic-dental-student-association.name: Hispanic Dental Student Association
hispanic-dental-student-association.description: The Hispanic Student Dental Association is a student-led organization at the University of Pennsylvania School of Dental Medicine dedicated to advancing oral health within Hispanic and underserved communities. Through education, community outreach, cultural engagement, advocacy, and professional development, HSDA strives to promote health equity, celebrate Hispanic cultures, and foster an inclusive environment that empowers future dental professionals to serve diverse patient populations.

hawaii-club.name: Hawaiʻi Club
hawaii-club.description: Aloha! The Hawaiʻi Club is dedicated to perpetuating the culture, history, and traditions of Hawaiʻi at the undergraduate level. Through community, events, and shared learning, we embrace the spirit of aloha and create a space where students can celebrate and explore Hawaiian culture together, whether you’re from Hawaiʻi or simply interested in learning more. Come grow with us and join our ʻohana!

penn-carey-law-softball-club.name: Penn Carey Law Softball Club
penn-carey-law-softball-club.description: The Penn Carey Law Softball Club aims to provide a fun and competitive environment for law students outside the classroom. We occasionally compete in recreational leagues in the fall and spring, or meet for intermittent practices throughout the year. The club's main event is the annual UVA Law School Softball Tournament in April. The club fields multiple competitive and casual teams for this weekend event.

wharton-marketing-club.name: Wharton Marketing Club
wharton-marketing-club.description: Our Mission is to connect students, alumni, faculty and recruiters in order to provide education, events, and opportunities to help our members pursue exciting careers that will advance the field of marketing

wharton-africa-students-association-wasa.name: Wharton Africa Students Association (WASA)
wharton-africa-students-association-wasa.description:
WASA is a Student-led focal point for Africa-related activities at the Wharton School
Members include MBA students from Africa, as well as students interested in African affairs and post-graduate employment
WASA offers a variety of year-long educational and cultural programming, career-related Africa treks, and networking opportunities

wharton-beauty-club.name: Wharton Beauty Club
wharton-beauty-club.description: Our mission is to create a space for all beauty, makeup and skincare enthusiasts (and those who aspire to be!) to bond with other like-minded Whartonites about everything beauty.
wharton-beauty-club.how_to_get_involved: Please formally join the club on Campus Groups: https://groups.wharton.upenn.edu/Beauty/club_signup

wharton-caribbean-business-club-caribiz.name: Wharton Caribbean Business Club (CariBiz)
wharton-caribbean-business-club-caribiz.description: The Caribbean Business Club exists to reframe the Caribbean as a connected investment ecosystem, not a collection of islands. We bring Wharton MBAs face-to-face with the region's operators, capital, and diaspora leaders across policy, industry, and innovation. Whether through our St. Lucia Trek or panels, we're building the bridge between Wharton and the region

osaphilly.name: Omani Student Organization at Penn (OSO Penn)
osaphilly.description:
The Omani Student Organization at Penn is a vibrant community of Omani students enrolled in the English Language Program (ELP) at Fisher Bennett Hall. Our primary goal is to promote and celebrate the rich and diverse aspects of Omani culture through various activities. We firmly believe that cultural exchange is crucial for building bridges of understanding between Omanis and the Penn community.
Our organization is committed to providing a platform for our fellow students and the wider community to learn more about Oman's history, traditions, and way of life. We organize various events such as cultural festivals, lectures, and workshops that showcase the unique and fascinating aspects of Omani culture. These events are open to all interested in learning more about Oman and its people.
Our organization strives to create a welcoming and inclusive environment where all students can feel at home and make new friends.

onyx-senior-honor-society.name: Onyx Senior Honor Society
onyx-senior-honor-society.description:
The Onyx Senior Honor Society represents the highest standards of academic excellence and leadership among the diverse groups at the University of Pennsylvania. The members of the Society have achieved outstanding academic merit and have proven themselves devoted to the university's tradition, diversity, and citizenship. 
Founded in 1974, Onyx originally sought to establish supporting institutions for underrepresented students at Penn, address university issues through open forums, and provide programming for academic achievement and networking. Today, the Society continues to perpetuate its tenets of heritage, humanity, and humility through community service, academic support workshops, and alumni engagement.

run-club.name: Run Club at Penn Carey Law
run-club.description: The Penn Law Run Club builds community, resilience, and well-being by bringing students of all paces together to run, reset, and support one another throughout the school year!

wharton-private-equity-venture-capital-c.name: Wharton Private Equity & Venture Capital Club (PE/VC)
wharton-private-equity-venture-capital-c.description: The club is for MBA students interested in U.S. and international private equity, venture capital, growth equity, private credit, secondaries, and PE operations across industries, whether or not they have prior PE or VC experience. Our mission is to help members learn about investing, build relationships with experienced professionals, pursue career opportunities, and excel over the long term.
